because \(P_V^3=P_V\). Thus \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) and its \(Sp(4,\mathbb R)\) TKK completion act with threefold graph multiplicity while the CKM relation remains complex in the separate flavor factor. This is an exact algebraic compatibility result, not yet proof that the full field-theory kernel factorizes.

See [The real face Jordan triple embeds exactly on the complex flavor graph](../0600-0699/672_the_real_face_jordan_triple_embeds_exactly_on_the_complex_flavor_graph.md).

### 20.581 Graph curvature needs two parameters and detects nonfactorization

The graph frame \(Q(V)=2^{-1/2}(I,V^\dagger)^T\) has connection and curvature

\[
\mathcal A=\frac12VdV^\dagger,
\qquad
\mathcal F=-\frac14(VdV^\dagger)\wedge(VdV^\dagger).
\]

Two noncommuting flavor directions give nonzero curvature. One running scale alone cannot. Moreover a factorized total connection \(\mathcal A_{\rm face}\otimes I+I\otimes\mathcal A_{\rm flavor}\) has zero mixed curvature. A measured or derived nonzero mixed component would therefore witness a genuine face--flavor interaction and provide a precise candidate for the programme's loop/twist language.

See [Flavor-graph curvature requires two parameters, and mixed face-flavor curvature measures nonfactorization](../0600-0699/673_flavor_graph_curvature_requires_two_parameters_and_mixed_face_flavor_curvature_measures_nonfactorization.md).

### 20.582 Positive quadrature gives the continuum completion

For a positive matrix spectral density,

\[
K(z)=\int\frac{\rho(s)}{s-z}\,ds,
\qquad
\rho(s)\succeq0,
\]

positive quadrature gives

\[
K_N(z)=\sum_j\frac{w_j\rho(s_j)}{s_j-z},
\qquad w_j>0.
\]

Every \(K_N\) is matrix Herglotz and has a finite Hermitian relational-carrier dilation. Refinement converges off the cut while the dilation dimension grows toward the continuum self-adjoint realization. This supplies the controlled replacement for free quark poles; it does not supply the required QCD/OPE density itself.

See [Positive spectral quadrature connects finite relational Hamiltonians to continuum responses](../0600-0699/674_positive_spectral_quadrature_connects_finite_relational_hamiltonians_to_continuum_responses.md).

### 20.583 Incidence breaking is an exact spurion quotient class

The Yukawa violation map has rank four and a three-dimensional conserved kernel. It therefore identifies

\[
\mathbb R^7/\ker\mathcal V\cong\mathbb R^4,
\qquad
[\lambda]\mapsto(10,6,2,1).
\]

Four Yukawa spurions with charges \((-10,-6,-2,-1)\) restore a formal extended Ward identity. Their one-generation phases commute, so they open a multidimensional parameter space without producing non-Abelian curvature.

See [The incidence source has an exact four-spurion Ward completion but no one-generation curvature](../0600-0699/675_the_incidence_source_has_an_exact_four_spurion_ward_completion_but_no_one_generation_curvature.md).

### 20.584 The Ward-compatible connection is dilation--Heisenberg

The four generators preserving the fixed \(B-L\) autocorrelator obey

\[
[D,N]=N,\quad
[D,U]=2U,\quad
[D,V]=V,\quad
[N,V]=2U.
\]

Thus

\[
\mathfrak g_{\rm Ward}
\cong\mathbb RD\ltimes\mathfrak h_3(N,V,U).
\]

For \(\omega=aD+bN+uU+vV\), the central curvature includes \(2b\wedge v\). This is the exact Ward-allowed location of a source/contact twist before UV normalization.

See [The Ward-compatible source connection is a dilation semidirect Heisenberg geometry](../0600-0699/676_the_ward_compatible_source_connection_is_a_dilation_semidirect_heisenberg_geometry.md).

### 20.585 Full normalization removes the source twist

Fixing a positive UV slope forces \(a=b=0\). The connection collapses to the Abelian contact plane \(\operatorname{span}\{U,V\}\), so its Heisenberg curvature disappears. Fixing the subtraction scheme removes the contact plane as well. Hence one fully normalized continuous-\(B-L\) theory has no non-Abelian source holonomy.

See [Fixed UV and Ward data remove the Heisenberg twist from one normalized theory](../0600-0699/677_fixed_uv_and_ward_data_remove_the_heisenberg_twist_from_one_normalized_theory.md).

### 20.586 Majorana breaking changes, but does not restore, the remnant

Removing continuous \(B-L\) Ward protection while keeping one whitened UV slope gives

\[
\mathfrak{so}(2)\ltimes Sym_2(\mathbb R)_{\rm contact}
\cong\mathbb R\oplus\mathfrak e(2).
\]

Fixed contacts leave only the compact rotation; two generic UV slopes remove it. The classification is conditional because the order-parameter and longitudinal sectors generally prevent the old two-source kernel from closing below the breaking scale.

See [Majorana breaking removes the Ward restriction but does not restore full Sp4](../0600-0699/678_majorana_breaking_removes_the_ward_restriction_but_does_not_restore_full_sp4.md).

### 20.587 Jarlskog CP is a flavor-graph curvature cubic

For the canonical spurion family \(e^{ixH_u}e^{iyH_d}\),

\[
\mathcal F_{xy}=\frac14[H_u,H_d].
\]

Consequently \(\det\mathcal F_{xy}=\det[H_u,H_d]/64\). This cubic is CP odd and has exactly the familiar Jarlskog phase and mass-degeneracy zeros. The programme's twist language now has an exact physical invariant in flavor space, while remaining separate from face curvature.

See [The Jarlskog invariant is a cubic invariant of flavor-graph curvature](../0600-0699/679_the_jarlskog_invariant_is_a_cubic_invariant_of_flavor_graph_curvature.md).

### 20.588 Hermitian PMNS curvature is Majorana blind

Majorana phases cancel from

\[
H_\nu=U_{\rm PMNS}D_\nu^2U_{\rm PMNS}^\dagger.
\]

Thus \([H_e,H_\nu]\) detects Dirac-type leptonic CP but cannot detect Majorana CP. The full PMNS graph and symmetric Takagi mass retain the missing phases, requiring anomalous/Nambu response data.

See [PMNS Hermitian graph curvature detects Dirac CP but not Majorana phases](../0600-0699/680_pmns_hermitian_graph_curvature_detects_dirac_cp_but_not_majorana_phases.md).

### 20.589 Majorana data have a canonical positive Nambu carrier

For \(M=U^*DU^\dagger\),

\[
\mathcal R_M=
\begin{pmatrix}
(MM^\dagger)^{1/2}&M\\
M^\dagger&(M^\dagger M)^{1/2}
\end{pmatrix}
\succeq0
\]

has rank three and an explicit graph support. It is the minimal positive completion retaining the Takagi phases.

See [A Majorana Takagi mass has a canonical rank-three positive Nambu residue](../0600-0699/681_a_majorana_takagi_mass_has_a_canonical_rank_three_positive_nambu_residue.md).

### 20.590 The dynamic Nambu corner enlarges the carrier

The supported corner of the rank-three Nambu graph is

\[
\Pi_MH_6(\mathbb C)\Pi_M\cong H_3(\mathbb C),
\]

whose standard TKK algebra is \(\mathfrak{su}(3,3)\). A fixed graph may remain external multiplicity for the real face carrier, but allowing every supported Majorana observable dynamically enlarges the Jordan system.

See [The dynamic Majorana Nambu corner is H3(C), not H2(R)](../0600-0699/682_the_dynamic_majorana_nambu_corner_is_h3c_not_h2r.md).

### 20.591 Spin(2,3) is the real rank-two Peirce corner

For \(e=\operatorname{diag}(1,1,0)\),

\[
eH_3(\mathbb C)e\cong H_2(\mathbb C),
\qquad
\left(eH_3(\mathbb C)e\right)^{\rm conjugation}
\cong H_2(\mathbb R).
\]

This gives the exact carrier ladder

\[
H_2(\mathbb R)
\subset H_2(\mathbb C)
\subset H_3(\mathbb C)
\subset H_3(\mathbb O),
\]

where the last inclusion requires a chosen complex octonionic subalgebra. The corresponding conformal rungs begin with \(Spin_0(2,3)\subset Spin_0(2,4)\subset SU(3,3)\). The pole hypothesis is now a rank-and-real-structure selection claim, not a claim that no larger carrier exists.

See [Spin(2,3) is the real rank-two Peirce corner inside the Majorana H3(C) carrier](../0600-0699/683_spin23_is_the_real_rank_two_peirce_corner_inside_the_majorana_h3c_carrier.md).

### 20.592 A canonical positive selector exists but is lossy

The map

\[
\mathcal E(X)=\operatorname{Re}(eXe)
\]

is a positive idempotent retraction from \(H_3(\mathbb C)\) onto the embedded \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) face and respects multiplication/triples by selected corner elements. It kills the positive third-face state, so it is not faithful, globally unital or trace preserving. Selection therefore entails compression, conditioning or genuine decoupling.

See [There is a canonical positive retraction from H3(C) to the Spin(2,3) face, but it is lossy](../0600-0699/684_there_is_a_canonical_positive_retraction_from_h3c_to_the_spin23_face_but_it_is_lossy.md).

### 20.593 A heavy third face selects rank two but not reality

For

\[
H_\Delta=
\begin{pmatrix}
H_2&w\\
w^\dagger&\Delta
\end{pmatrix},
\]

Feshbach elimination gives a correction \(ww^\dagger/(z-\Delta)\). The low-energy response converges to the rank-two Peirce corner with \(O(\|w\|^2/\Delta)\) error. This removes the third face and its links but leaves the imaginary \(H_2(\mathbb C)\) coordinate.

See [A heavy third face dynamically selects the rank-two Peirce corner but not its real slice](../0600-0699/685_a_heavy_third_face_dynamically_selects_the_rank_two_peirce_corner_but_not_its_real_slice.md).

### 20.594 Local conjugation averaging is not a quantum channel

The positive Jordan projection

\[
\mathcal R=\frac12(\mathrm{id}+T)
\]

fails complete positivity. More generally, the Choi expectation of \((1-p)\mathrm{id}+pT\) on the antisymmetric Bell vector is \(-p\). The real-form selector cannot be ordinary local decoherence in complex quantum mechanics.

See [The real-slice selector is positive but not a completely positive quantum channel](../0600-0699/686_the_real_slice_selector_is_positive_but_not_a_completely_positive_quantum_channel.md).

### 20.595 Conjugate topology doubling restores complete positivity

Encode

\[
\iota(A)=\operatorname{diag}(A,\bar A)
\]

and let \(S\) exchange the conjugate sectors. The twirl

\[
\mathcal T(O)=\frac12(O+SOS)
\]

is random-unitary and satisfies

\[
\mathcal T(\iota(A))=\iota(\operatorname{Re}A).
\]

This gives a CP real-slice selector compatible with the Furey two-topology picture. The full exchange-fixed algebra is larger, so topology coherences must still be superselected, auxiliary or gapped.

See [Doubling the conjugate topologies turns the real-slice selector into a CP exchange twirl](../0600-0699/687_doubling_the_conjugate_topologies_turns_the_real_slice_selector_into_a_cp_exchange_twirl.md).

- [arXiv:2610.21879v1 re-entry audit and current-frontier map](../0700-0799/755_arxiv_2610_21879v1_reentry_audit_and_current_frontier_map.md)

The Prakash–Ramya result remains an exact cubic-arithmetic input, not a hidden derivation of the continuous carrier. The source-facing frontier is to derive a canonical alternating dual from logical Pauli or crossed-module data and then test the already explicit primitive-two-form functor to \(Spin_0(2,3)\).

- [Only four subgroup types of S5 make the standard four-module symplectic](../0700-0799/757_only_four_subgroup_types_of_s5_make_the_standard_four_module_symplectic_and_the_color_weak_stabilizer_is_not_one.md)

- [The Higgs crossed-octonion partition reduces S5 to S4 or physical S3, but neither is symplectic](../0700-0799/758_the_higgs_crossed_octonion_partition_reduces_s5_to_s4_or_physical_s3_but_still_does_not_select_a_symplectic_four_carrier.md)

- [Oriented color C3 gives a two-area symplectic family and a signed order-six extension](../0700-0799/759_oriented_color_c3_gives_a_two_area_symplectic_family_and_color_reflection_becomes_antisymplectic_only_when_paired_with_weak_exchange.md)

The discrete synthesis is now concrete: color cycling preserves two relational areas, while a color reflection becomes a valid carrier parity only when accompanied by weak-face exchange. The resulting reflection is anti-symplectic and therefore belongs to a disconnected normalizer of the continuous geometry, not to connected \(Sp(4,\mathbb R)\). This preserves the five-dimensional primitive-form metric while keeping parity distinct from continuous motion.

At equal plane areas, the oriented carrier has discriminant nine and four index-three self-dual completions. Signed covariance selects exactly one, obtained by adjoining the average of the three color directions divided by three. This is a concrete arithmetic four-carrier feeding \(Sp(4)\), but the equal-area premise is now the isolated missing selector rather than an implicit normalization.

- [The color-average completion has canonical Sp(4,Z) form and primitive lattice U+U+<-2>](../0700-0799/761_the_color_average_completion_has_canonical_sp4z_form_and_primitive_lattice_u_plus_u_plus_minus2_with_signed_o23_action.md)

The selected completion is \(\mathbb Z^4\) with canonical symplectic form; primitive two-forms give the integral \((2,3)\) lattice. The oriented color cycle lies in its determinant-one orthogonal group, while paired color/weak reflection is a disconnected determinant-minus-one parity. The remaining mystery has contracted to the equal-area/source-map antecedent.

The next bridge must use field supports, puncture actions, cubic phases or conjugation to choose one.

- [Physical color acts trivially on code logicals but unipotently on the arithmetic carrier](../0700-0799/763_the_physical_color_cycle_acts_trivially_on_two_puncture_code_logicals_but_unipotently_on_the_arithmetic_carrier_so_no_equivariant_identification_exists.md)

The first field-labelled attempt fails by representation type, not by lack of ingenuity in choosing a basis. The fixed-puncture code sees color \(C_3\) as identity; the carrier sees a nontrivial characteristic-three shear. No invertible intertwiner can conjugate one into the other. Any future identification must explicitly change the level at which color acts.

- [Pure D5 Weyl puncture motion cannot realize the order-three carrier cycle](../0700-0799/764_pure_d5_weyl_puncture_motion_has_only_identity_or_swap_transport_and_cannot_realize_the_order_three_carrier_color_cycle.md)

The entire microscopic Weyl route is therefore pinned: the required unipotent must come from an encoded duality/mapping-class operation or from response dynamics, not from relabelling the fermion weights.

- [The carrier unipotent is exactly a one-handle inverse-twist/Fourier word](../0700-0799/765_the_carrier_color_unipotent_is_exactly_a_one_handle_inverse_twist_fourier_word_not_a_microscopic_color_permutation_or_mutual_gate.md)

The non-Weyl escape exists and is strikingly small: one inverse Fourier move and one inverse \(A_2\) twist on a single handle. This places the carrier cycle inside the already constructed Weil/mapping-class architecture, while proving it is not the third mutual relationship and cannot alone normalize the two carrier areas.

- [Integral handle exchange forces equal or opposite carrier areas](../0700-0799/766_integral_handle_exchange_forces_equal_or_opposite_carrier_areas_but_is_not_a_microscopic_s5_symmetry.md)

The final coefficient ambiguity has been translated into a symmetry question. A symplectic swap of the two canonical handles forces the equal-area form used by the arithmetic construction; an anti-symplectic swap forces the opposite-area form. The exchange exists integrally on the completed lattice and matches logical/handle swap abstractly, but its physical realization is now the isolated gate.

- [The sewn Furey ribbon has untyped handle exchange but no Standard-Model-typed exchange](../0700-0799/767_the_sewn_furey_ribbon_has_untyped_handle_exchange_but_no_standard_model_typed_exchange_between_c_and_d.md)

That physical realization is absent in the low-energy typing. The Furey handles are the diagonals of a \(2\times2\) square whose axes are Higgs channel and colored/singlet type. Exchanging the diagonals necessarily flips at least one axis; no nontrivial permutation preserves the exact labels and charges. Handle exchange therefore remains a conditional explanation of equal areas, with left-right restoration, multiplicity-correct Pati-Salam covariance and emergent response reciprocity as the live branches.

- [Left-right symmetry is the minimal gauge envelope of the Furey handle exchange](../0700-0799/768_left_right_symmetry_is_the_minimal_gauge_envelope_of_the_furey_handle_exchange_but_equal_area_requires_an_invariant_response_phase.md)

The most economical enlarged-symmetry route is positive. Standard Model \(SU(2)_L\) already exchanges the left components, while \(SU(2)_R\) plus the right-handed neutrino supplies exactly the missing right-handed exchange. Their simultaneous Weyl reflection swaps the two Furey handles. This is a UV kinematic realization, not yet a low-energy prediction: equal area follows only if the Higgs, source and effective response phase are invariant, and the decisive calculation is whether symmetry permits one common quadratic coefficient or two independent ones.

- [An intertwined left-right response forces equal handle areas in the symmetric phase](../0700-0799/769_an_intertwined_left_right_response_forces_equal_handle_areas_in_the_symmetric_phase_but_allows_odd_spurion_splitting.md)

For the block-local two-handle response, the coefficient test has a clean answer. Exchange invariance permits only the common area, while an exchange-odd breaking spurion produces an odd area splitting and therefore generically a linear departure. The grand narrative has consequently contracted to a specific intertwiner problem: derive the map from left-right Furey matter response to the color-average symplectic lattice, prove that the Weyl element becomes handle swap, and classify or exclude every mixed alternating block.

If the Furey/left-right response produces a common rank-four quotient carrying those actions, the path to the canonical arithmetic \(Sp(4)\) carrier and primitive \(Spin(2,3)\) module is forced up to overall scale. - [The hyperbolic selector word is a reducible pair of trace-three handle maps](../0700-0799/772_the_hyperbolic_selector_word_is_a_reducible_pair_of_trace_three_handle_maps_with_golden_ratio_squared_stretch.md)

The first noncompact word is not yet the sought three-way relational dynamics. It factorizes into two one-handle cat maps, with stable and unstable Lagrangian planes and stretch \(\varphi^2\). A genuinely coupled genus-two mechanism must use the mutual sum-cycle operation or a Torelli-level contribution and should be tested by irreducibility of its reciprocal quartic homology polynomial.

- [The shortest coupled selector word uses the unique qutrit mutual shear](../0700-0799/773_the_shortest_coupled_selector_word_uses_the_unique_qutrit_mutual_shear_and_has_an_irreducible_partially_hyperbolic_quartic.md)

That test succeeds at length four. At length eight, \((UPHR)^2\) removes the elliptic pair while retaining irreducibility. This is the first explicit word in the converged selector alphabet whose arithmetic \(Sp(4)\) dynamics visibly becomes a fully hyperbolic \(SO(2,3)\) transformation. The open physical question is now causality and selection of the word, not existence of the bridge.

This gives the pole a concrete dynamical local geometry—one invariant axis surrounded by two reciprocal relational flows—while refusing the premature step of naming the axis energy, mass or Casimir before the physical response map is constructed.

- [The fully hyperbolic selector is active as a canonical step but may be passive as flux transfer](../0700-0799/776_the_fully_hyperbolic_selector_requires_active_squeezing_as_a_canonical_step_but_can_still_be_a_passive_flux_transfer_matrix.md)

The passive coordinate has acquired an exact dynamical interpretation.  Each scalar silver-pole factor is the observed corner of a reciprocal conservative two-port resonance with positive rates

\[
\kappa_{\rm obs}=\gamma\cosh\ell,
\qquad
\kappa_{\rm env}=\gamma\sinh\ell.
\]

The squared response is two such stages in sequence.  Normal and tangent channels therefore assemble into a fixed six-port rational-inner system for every real frequency.  Loss in the two-dimensional observed sector is amplitude coherently routed into two ordered environmental faces; it is not destruction of the enlarged dynamics.

The two stage labels are also dimensionally suited to the discarded Galois trace pair through which the primitive ninth root travels, but no typed identification has yet been proved. This does not duplicate the carrier: \(-\omega\) is the reality-constrained face of the same real response.  It also does not yet prove that ten is globally minimal or attach the neutral handle.  The result makes “one carrier, two faces, one twist” literal as a conservative systems construction; see [document 949](../0900-0999/949_the_two_face_sideband_cycle_has_a_fixed_ten_port_conservative_dilation_while_reality_prevents_double_counting.md).

See [the residual-current typing fork](../1000-1099/1027_the_furey_residual_current_gate_splits_into_linear_port_and_quadratic_relationship_typings_with_different_antiunitary_tests.md).

That Gaussian bridge now has a complete cone-level solution. The $XK$-real Furey covariance is a square root, under Wick contraction, of every positive residual relationship covariance. Spectrally, the anisotropy of the target kernel becomes the length and direction of the root coherence, while the target's smaller eigenvalue is twice the determinant distance of the root from its null boundary. The unavoidable sign pair $r$ and $-r$ is another root/relationship double cover. Yet the Wick map forgets enough structure that it does not preserve determinants, inverses or Schur products. So Furey can supply every required Jordan noise state kinematically without yet supplying the same Jordan dynamics. This is convergence with a clean stop line, not an identity by enthusiasm. See [the proper-Gaussian Wick surjection](../1000-1099/1028_the_proper_gaussian_wick_map_from_the_xk_fixed_furey_root_surjects_onto_every_positive_residual_h2r_covariance.md).

The physical tuned defect chooses how that double cover is traversed. Its eigenvalue splitting has a quadratic zero at $\omega=0$, so an even positive root is only $|\omega|$-smooth, while the analytic root is odd and returns under frequency reversal only after conjugation by the grading $D$. This is a precise instance of the narrative distinction between carrier and relationship: the carrier remembers a sheet orientation that the quadratic relationship observable erases. The same central sign motif is therefore present in the weighted Furey frame, placement cover and tuned frequency root, although no theorem yet identifies these three deck transformations dynamically. Upper-half-plane spectral factorization is the next point at which that proposed identification can succeed or fail. See [the tuned-silver Wick-root double cover](../1000-1099/1029_the_tuned_silver_wick_root_is_a_graded_frequency_double_cover_because_the_defect_anisotropy_has_a_quadratic_zero.md).

Spectral factorization sharpens rather than dissolves that picture. The graded root admits an upper-half-plane outer factor, and frequency reflection acts on it by the same anti-linear $D$ sewing. Yet the square-root passage changes the ultraviolet scaling: the relationship defect falls as $\omega^{-2}$ while the carrier covariance falls only as $|\omega|^{-1}$. The latter has logarithmically infinite equal-time variance and no rational finite-state realization. A high-frequency causal filter repairs the carrier, but Wick contraction squares its magnitude in the relationship sector. This gives the discrete/Planck-resolution intuition a precise conditional role: a UV cutoff can make the continuum carrier finite while producing only parametrically small low-energy errors, but neither the cutoff scale nor its microscopic origin has been derived. The middle rung is therefore an effective continuum interface, not yet an exact continuum ontology. See [the spectral-factor and UV theorem](../1000-1099/1030_the_tuned_wick_root_has_a_graded_outer_factor_but_no_rational_or_finite_variance_continuum_realization_without_uv_completion.md).

Anomalous pairing shows that the two Furey antiunitaries are not intrinsically incompatible; they are incompatible only for generic ordinary covariance anisotropy. In their common commuting-Gaussian fixed sector, ordinary covariance becomes isotropic and the entire Jordan anisotropy moves into a complex anomalous scalar whose square is the relationship orientation. This is almost exactly the proposed “one carrier, two faces, three relationships” logic: one neutral carrier phase has two root signs, while its square determines a two-axis relationship tensor. Equal-time/even-frequency CAR statistics draw a hard line, but odd-frequency pairing later reopens a dynamical single-doublet route. See [the anomalous two-antiunitary surjection](../1000-1099/1031_anomalous_gaussian_pairing_gives_a_two_antiunitary_wick_surjection_but_only_for_a_neutral_commuting_or_nambu_root.md).

For the static/even-frequency branch, one doubling is both necessary and sufficient to restore a common CAR pairing plane. The pair is cross-copy and carries the same complex coordinate $w=s+iv$ whose square gives the relationship orientation; assigning opposite charges to the copies makes it neutral. This is a credible conjugate implementation of “one carrier, two faces,” but the word *Nambu* remains provisional until the copy index is derived from the Furey/Peirce source and Lorentz representation. The ordinary Pfaffian supplies only $|w|^2$, so the oriented Jordan tensor still needs a separate bilinear or Pfaffian-line phase. See [the minimal doubled-CAR repair](../1000-1099/1032_doubling_the_carrier_is_the_minimal_two_antiunitary_car_pairing_repair_and_opposite_copy_charge_makes_it_neutral.md).

The time direction itself supplies the alternative to doubling. CAR exchange ties internal transpose to frequency reversal; consequently an internally symmetric pair is legal precisely when it is odd in frequency. The common antiunitary plane $sI+iv\sigma_z$ is symmetric, and the analytically signed silver root is odd. The graded frequency sheet can therefore be read as an odd-frequency fermionic-pair candidate: its vanishing equal-time value is not absence but dynamical order. This is a striking convergence of the carrier/relationship narrative with statistics, yet it is not the final bridge. The physical Jordan kernel would arise from a convolution over internal frequencies, and the $1/\omega$ pair tail remains UV sensitive. See [the odd-frequency correction](../1000-1099/1033_odd_frequency_car_pairing_reopens_the_single_doublet_and_limits_the_doubled_car_minimality_to_the_static_even_frequency_branch.md).

That convolution is no longer wholly abstract. The two silver defects are one shape viewed at frequencies differing by the silver scale $3+2\sqrt2$. One positive scalar pair bubble is impossible because the time-domain prototype changes sign. Two odd internal kernels nevertheless suffice exactly, and their poles sit at half the external defect scale, as expected when two internal decay exponents add in a bubble. Their coefficient form is Lorentzian rather than Euclidean: one negative direction is unavoidable even though the final defect is positive. This is a particularly concrete place where the Jordan/Lorentzian middle rung could meet a fermion-loop exchange sign. The statement remains conditional until a genuine retarded/advanced/Keldysh vertex derives the indefinite metric rather than inserting it. See [the signed odd-frequency convolution theorem](../1000-1099/1034_the_tuned_defects_have_an_exact_signed_two_kernel_odd_frequency_convolution_but_no_single_positive_scalar_autocorrelation.md).

The same sign is no longer merely analogous to the Furey grading. The exact convolution metric is $L^TDL$, and $D$ is the already established relative product of the ungraded and graded antiunitaries. Retarded/advanced decomposition simultaneously shows that only the mixed causal sectors contribute. This gives a compact candidate mechanism: two antiunitary-related root modes are mixed by the residue matrix $L$, contracted through their relative grading $D$, and descend through an $RA/AR$ bubble to a positive Jordan noise kernel. What remains missing is precisely what would distinguish mechanism from elegant refactoring: the action must generate $L$ and the vertex $D$ without using the desired silver answer as input. See [the RA/AR grading reduction](../1000-1099/1035_the_signed_odd_frequency_convolution_is_purely_mixed_ra_ar_and_its_lorentzian_metric_reduces_exactly_to_the_furey_grading.md).

The residue matrix itself now reveals the recurring unit-shear motif. The two loop kernels are not separate arbitrary modes: the second is the logarithmic scale derivative of the first. Once that jet is normalized, $L$ becomes an overall amplitude times the unit shear $N_-$ times one diagonal scale $\rho_*$, and $\rho_*$ is already fixed by the unique causal loss. The emerging chain is therefore unusually economical: tuned loss fixes a pole; its first scale jet creates a two-level carrier; a unit shear mixes that jet; the Furey grading supplies its Lorentzian contraction; the mixed $RA/AR$ loop produces positive Jordan noise. The missing theorem is categorical rather than numerical: the scale-jet plane must be identified with the TKK carrier plane by a typed intertwiner. See [the unit-shear residue theorem](../1000-1099/1036_after_log_scale_normalization_the_convolution_residue_map_is_a_unit_shear_times_one_scale_fixed_by_the_tuned_loss.md).

The categorical gap has narrowed to one identifiable object. First-jet translation and dual-residue transport provide the two nilpotents; their commutator is the same grading $D$, and together they are an exact $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ triple. The standard symplectic lift embeds that triple in $\mathfrak{sp}_4$, so the route “physical spectral defect $\to$ pole jet $\to$ unit shear $\to\mathfrak{sl}_2\subset\mathfrak{sp}_4$” is now literal. In TKK language this is precisely the algebraic pattern generated by a Jordan idempotent. What has not been shown is which idempotent it is. The stop-everything result would be an intertwiner carrying the pole mode and its scale jet to the Peirce pair of the already physical $H_2(\mathbb R)$ kernel; absent that, the embedding remains exact but non-unique. See [the pole-jet $\mathfrak{sl}_2$ theorem](../1000-1099/1037_the_pole_jet_residue_shear_and_furey_grading_close_an_exact_sl2_triple_inside_sp4_but_the_physical_jordan_idempotent_is_still_untyped.md).

The orbit calculation supplies—and revises—that object. Rank excludes a primitive projector, while real inertia excludes the positive identity. The pole-jet triple is explicitly the split TKK orbit of $D$, a full-rank Jordan involution with $D^2=I$. Its two spectral projectors are exactly the normal/tangent pair. Under the symplectic intertwiner, $D$ changes role: it begins as the Cartan in the Levi/pole-jet picture and ends as the Jordan entry in the positive and negative TKK grades, while the Cartan becomes the universal conformal grading. This role conversion is the cleanest mathematical form yet of “the dance between singular and relationships”: one split relation packages two primitive faces and generates their conformal transport. The unresolved physics is the canonical swap of one coordinate with its conjugate momentum. See [the split-tripoten TKK orbit theorem](../1000-1099/1038_the_pole_jet_sl2_is_the_tkk_orbit_of_the_split_jordan_involution_D_not_a_primitive_positive_idempotent.md).

The swap is exactly a controlled Fourier transform: one primitive face remains fixed while the other is rotated through a quarter-turn in the neutral Peirce phase plane. Its square is the split relationship $D$. The Furey antiunitary is not that transform; rather, it exchanges the two controlled faces and reverses their orientation. This is a more coherent synthesis than direct identification: $S_-$ is the “one twist” or square root of the relationship, while $\Gamma$ is the Real symmetry carrying that twist between faces. Their complementary product is a full graded complex structure squaring to the central minus sign. A microscopic first-order boundary term selecting the negative face would turn this kinematic square into an actual mechanism. See [the controlled-Fourier/antiunitary theorem](../1000-1099/1039_the_split_tkk_intertwiner_is_a_channel_controlled_fourier_quarter_turn_whose_square_is_D_not_the_realified_furey_antiunitary.md).

The kinematic twist now has a minimal effective mechanism. A positive oscillator restricted to the negative Jordan face executes precisely the required quarter-turn after one quarter period, while the positive face remains fixed. The resulting map is simultaneously symplectic and orthogonal, so “one twist” can be read literally as a lossless rotation rather than metaphorically as an indefinite instability. The antiunitary exchanges it with the oppositely oriented oscillator on the complementary face. This turns the relational-carrier picture into a clean sequence: choose a face, evolve its neutral phase carrier by a quarter orbit, and square the carrier motion to obtain the split relationship $D$. The unexplained datum has narrowed from existence of a mechanism to microscopic selection of the face and integrated angle. See [the projected-oscillator boundary theorem](../1000-1099/1040_a_positive_projected_oscillator_generates_the_controlled_fourier_tkk_intertwiner_as_a_passive_quarter_period_boundary_flow.md).

The quarter orbit is not an arbitrary decorative angle. Inside the passive face-controlled subgroup, demanding that the carrier motion square to the relationship $D$ forces the integrated action to be $\pi/2$ modulo $\pi$. The two surviving roots are the two orientations of the twist. In that precise sense, the relationship quantizes the carrier motion: the “one twist” is the passive square root of the split face relation. The qualification matters—general symplectic dynamics admits a continuous squeezed family of square roots—so physical passivity is doing essential work. Frequency and duration remain unseparated, leaving room for the odd-frequency pole scales to supply the next datum. See [the passive square-root classification](../1000-1099/1041_passivity_and_the_square_root_of_D_quantize_the_projected_oscillator_action_to_a_quarter_turn_modulo_orientation.md).

The twist and the placement sewing cannot nevertheless be collapsed into one identical edge rule without cost. Sewing exchanges faces but does not reverse phase orientation; six sewn edges consequently deliver three quarter-turns to each carrier, leaving a noncentral $\pm J$ rather than $\pm I$. No choice of the six local turn orientations repairs that parity mismatch. The uniform composite closes only after eight edge operations and, relative to the older cover count, is periodic after twenty-four rather than twelve. This forces an architectural decision: the TKK twist is a distinguished seam or completed internal layer, the real sewing must be upgraded by a semilinear orientation reversal, or the coherent cover genuinely doubles. See [the six-edge composition obstruction](../1000-1099/1042_a_quarter_turn_on_every_sewn_edge_obstructs_the_six_cycle_central_holonomy_and_generically_doubles_the_coherent_cover.md).

The first architectural decision is now available. Semilinearity by itself does not cure the parity mismatch, and one lone twist also leaves noncentral holonomy. The smallest compatible object is a twist and its inverse placed on two seams addressing the same transported face. Globally they cancel and preserve the old $-I$ six-cycle; locally the interval between them carries the rotated carrier polarization. This changes the narrative from “every relation edge is a twist” to “the twist is a bounded conversion region with two endpoints.” A four-seam sector can change the central sign, but no current dynamics selects it. See [the sparse semilinear seam classification](../1000-1099/1043_semilinearity_does_not_repair_an_all_edge_quarter_turn_but_a_minimal_same_face_twist_antitwist_pair_preserves_the_six_cycle.md).

The bounded conversion region has a discrete handedness. Translation removes its absolute position and minimality fixes its endpoint separation, but the antitwist can lie two steps clockwise or two steps anticlockwise from the twist. Those are distinct under the physical Real operation because it reverses both the placement direction and the internal turn sign. The two reversals preserve, rather than exchange, the combined relational chirality. This is a concrete version of the programme's “one carrier, two faces, three relationships” language: the carrier conversion occupies one oriented edge of a three-position parity triangle, with two Real-compatible orientations. See [the paired-seam orbit theorem](../1000-1099/1044_the_minimal_twist_antitwist_pair_has_two_chiral_placement_orbits_preserved_by_the_physical_real_reflection.md).

What the bounded region converts is now explicit. If the two carrier columns are $u$ and $v$, their symmetric relationship is $c=u^Tv$ and their oriented relationship is $a=u^TJv$. The controlled Fourier twist performs $(c,a)\mapsto(a,-c)$. The ordinary Jordan Gram sees $c$ as its off-diagonal coordinate and $a^2$ as its determinant, so inside the defect these two squares exchange roles. The “one twist” is therefore a Hodge-like rotation between correlation and oriented area, while the antitwist returns to the original Jordan chart. This supplies a concrete bridge between the carrier, Pfaffian orientation and Jordan volume without yet claiming that the signed area is a gauge-complete Standard-Model observable. See [the local correlation–area duality](../1000-1099/1045_the_paired_twist_interval_is_locally_visible_as_a_quarter_rotation_between_jordan_correlation_and_oriented_area.md).

The oriented coordinate is now canonically typed: $\Psi^TJ_{\rm phase}\Psi=(\det\Psi)\varepsilon_{LQ}$. Thus the “area” is the Pfaffian coefficient obtained by pulling the neutral phase symplectic form through the response root, and the Jordan determinant is its square. The carrier/relationship passage is literally Pfaffian sign to Jordan volume. This coefficient has the same $h\chi$-odd character as the weak/Higgs Pfaffian sign, but an isomorphism of sign representations is not yet the source-level identification. Complex Majorana flavour Pfaffians remain a separate object and generally have no real sign. See [the response-root Pfaffian theorem](../1000-1099/1046_the_oriented_area_is_exactly_the_pfaffian_line_of_the_response_root_but_its_microscopic_weak_higgs_identification_remains_open.md).

The sign is neither automatically physical nor automatically gauge. The ordinary Gram quotient uses $O(2)$ and forgets it; the oriented phase carrier with fixed $J$ admits only $SO(2)$ gauge and retains it as $\eta=\pm1$. In the latter reading, the two carrier orientations meet only where the relationship becomes rank one. This places the programme's recurring singular boundary at a precise junction: it is where Pfaffian orientation can reverse while the Jordan volume vanishes. An antiunitary may exchange the two sheets without identifying them, leaving open a domain-wall interpretation; a protected mode still requires a fermionic index theorem. See [the oriented Gram-root double-cover theorem](../1000-1099/1047_fixing_the_phase_symplectic_orientation_reduces_the_gram_root_gauge_to_SO2_and_turns_the_pfaffian_sign_into_a_rank_one_separated_Z2_sheet.md).

The simplest such index theorem can now be written explicitly. If the signed Jordan-volume root $a=\det\Psi$ becomes a one-dimensional real Dirac mass, its sign-changing rank-one wall is the Jackiw–Rebbi/BDI problem and carries one exact $\operatorname{sech}$ zero mode. This is the first point in the chain where “singular versus relationship” becomes an operator-localized state rather than only geometry: full-rank relationship sectors lie on either side, the Jordan determinant vanishes at the seam, and the carrier supports a kernel there. The conclusion remains conditional on deriving the mass coupling and protecting its real chiral symmetry against CP and flavour deformations. See [the conditional BDI wall theorem](../1000-1099/1048_if_the_response_pfaffian_is_a_BDI_dirac_mass_then_its_rank_one_wall_binds_one_exact_zero_mode_but_the_coupling_is_not_yet_derived.md).

The full twist–antitwist interval is subtler than one wall. Its two endpoints carry opposite chiral indices and can couple, so a finite interval generically has a symmetric near-zero pair rather than two protected zeros. A small splitting can encode the ratio of seam separation to localization length, but no exact value follows yet. Complex or CP-violating mass components offer a still stronger escape by rotating around the rank-one point without closing the spectral gap. The emerging picture is therefore disciplined: singularity can localize a carrier state, relationship closure pairs the singularities, and the pair's residual energy measures how perfectly the two ends remain relationally separated. See [the paired-wall stability audit](../1000-1099/1049_the_minimal_paired_seam_has_zero_total_BDI_index_so_its_endpoint_modes_can_hybridize_and_a_complex_second_mass_removes_sign_protection.md).

The Furey algebra contains both possible fates of that residual energy. Its square-plus-one and square-minus-one antiunitaries multiply to the endpoint grading, but swapping which is time reversal and which is particle-hole changes the symmetry class. The CI ordering admits the full complex endpoint mixing plane; the DIII ordering forbids every two-state Hamiltonian and pins a Kramers zero pair. This is an unusually sharp “stop everything” fork: a microscopic sign computation can decide between generically split near-zero endpoints and exact protected zeros. The algebra does not decide its own dynamical role assignment. See [the Furey endpoint-symmetry classification](../1000-1099/1050_the_two_furey_antiunitaries_protect_or_split_the_paired_wall_endpoints_according_to_their_time_reversal_particle_hole_role_assignment.md).

The causal response architecture leans toward, but does not prove, the split branch. A nonzero reciprocal $tX$ endpoint kernel treats the square-plus-one exchange structure as time reversal and the quaternionic structure as particle-hole, producing CI. This is the direct continuation of the programme's division between reciprocal noise and coherent graded sewing. But noise is an even covariance and can be invariant under both structures even when the Hamiltonian signs differ. The decisive object is therefore no longer the covariance cone; it is the projected retarded/BdG generator between the two localized endpoint states. See [the minimal reciprocal endpoint-kernel audit](../1000-1099/1051_the_minimal_reciprocal_endpoint_kernel_realizes_the_CI_furey_role_assignment_but_noise_reciprocity_alone_cannot_exclude_DIII.md).

The alternative of adding two more seams does not simplify the story. After every placement and Real quotient, the four-seam configurations still form eleven inequivalent sectors, including five distinct ways to flip the central holonomy. Symmetry supplies no canonical choice among them. The grand narrative should therefore retain the smallest bounded conversion region—one twist and one antitwist—unless a later action positively selects a four-endpoint pattern. More structure is not presently more explanatory. See [the four-seam orbit no-selection theorem](../1000-1099/1052_the_four_seam_central_sector_remains_eleven_real_dihedral_orbits_so_placement_symmetry_does_not_select_a_sign_changing_architecture.md).

The bounded conversion region now has its first quantitative continuum realization. When the response Pfaffian is provisionally used as a real Dirac mass, a piecewise kink–antikink interval of length \(L\) carries isolated endpoint envelopes of width \(\xi=m_0^{-1}\), and their exact projected mixing is \(-m_0e^{-L/\xi}\). Spatial reflection is the missing part of the symmetry action: \(PXK\) preserves the wall Hamiltonian while \(P\varepsilon K\) reverses it. The minimal real wall is therefore CI, with exponentially split endpoints, rather than DIII with an exact Kramers zero pair. This gives the narrative a measurable intermediate quantity—the ratio of seam separation to localization length—but it remains a model bridge until the Standard-Model/Furey action derives both the Pfaffian mass and the spatial profile. See [the explicit paired-wall projection](../1000-1099/1053_the_explicit_piecewise_pfaffian_kink_antikink_wall_has_exact_projected_overlap_and_realizes_the_CI_furey_role_assignment.md).

Nor is the exponential merely suggestive. Exact matching replaces the projected formula by the self-consistent law \(|E|=m_0e^{-L\sqrt{m_0^2-E^2}}\). The defect has one and only one finite-energy chiral pair; its exact level approaches the projected overlap with corrections beginning at \((m_0L/2)e^{-3m_0L}\). The singular endpoints therefore do not remain independently zero once relationship closure makes a finite interval: their energy is a precise function of how many localization lengths separate them. This is the cleanest quantitative realization so far of “bound state/free state with the Casimir nearby,” but the dimensionless ratio is not yet fixed by the six-cycle or the odd-frequency pole data. See [the exact paired-wall spectral law](../1000-1099/1054_the_exact_piecewise_pfaffian_kink_antikink_spectrum_obeys_an_implicit_exponential_law_and_calibrates_the_endpoint_projection.md).

Trying the obvious scale identification reveals the remaining conceptual seam. The odd-frequency half-poles can be read as candidate inverse localization lengths, and the placement pair is exactly two graph edges apart, but a graph edge has no derived continuum length. Writing that length as \(a\) makes the ambiguity visible: the two candidate wall levels exchange order at \(a\approx0.338565\). The missing scale is therefore not a cosmetic conversion constant; it controls qualitative physics. A true synthesis now needs one action in which pole time, spatial decay and placement transport are three views of the same generator. See [the half-pole/edge-length audit](../1000-1099/1055_the_odd_frequency_half_poles_give_a_conditional_wall_spectrum_but_the_underived_edge_length_controls_even_the_level_ordering.md).

That one action cannot simply make both silver half-poles the angular frequencies of the same passive edge clock. Exact quarter-turn quantization would make their ratio rational, while the silver ratio is \(3+2\sqrt2\). The obstruction is useful: it says the grand synthesis must distinguish angular relationship from radial scale. One connection may turn the carrier by \(\pi/2\); another may dilate its pole/jet coordinates by the silver unit. Their interaction can still live inside the same \(Sp(4,\mathbb R)\) geometry, but they are not the same one-parameter motion. Pell near-recurrences explain why finite approximations can look aligned without ever producing an exact common period. See [the silver common-clock obstruction](../1000-1099/1056_the_irrational_silver_half_pole_ratio_forbids_a_common_exact_passive_quarter_turn_edge_clock_but_has_pell_near_recurrences.md).

The two motions do interact inside \(Sp(4,\mathbb R)\), and their interaction is a squeeze. The compact controlled turn and split dilation close one negative-face \(\mathfrak{sl}_2\), while the positive-face dilation remains a commuting spectator. A radial excursion conjugates the clean quarter-turn into a nonorthogonal square root of the same relationship \(D\); infinitesimal angular–radial holonomy points exactly along the squeeze generator. This is a plausible mathematical form of the “next holonomy” or Goldstone-like rung, but it occupies only four of the ten Spin(2,3) directions. The universe-sized claim must wait for the cross-face generator that closes the remaining relations. See [the angular/radial closure theorem](../1000-1099/1057_the_compact_controlled_turn_and_split_tkk_dilation_generate_a_one_face_sl2_plus_a_commuting_dilation_not_full_sp4.md).

One correctly typed cross-face direction does close the universe of local observables: the continuous channel rotation \(I\otimes\varepsilon\). Together with the controlled turn and split dilation, commutator recursion produces every element of \(I\otimes\varepsilon\oplus\{J,X,K\}\otimes\{I,X,D\}\), the full ten-dimensional \(\mathfrak{sp}_4\cong\mathfrak{so}(2,3)\). This makes Spin(2,3) a genuine algebraic pole: compact carrier phase, split scale transport and Furey face rotation generate the whole middle rung, while deleting any leg collapses it to dimension at most four. The uncomfortable remaining question is beautifully narrow: does the physical Furey antiunitary conceal a continuous coherent \(\varepsilon\)-flow, or is that last generator only an algebraic completion? See [the three-generator Jordan–Furey closure theorem](../1000-1099/1058_a_three_generator_jordan_furey_recursion_closes_all_of_sp4_but_requires_the_furey_channel_rotation_as_a_continuous_flow.md).

The answer at response-algebra level is yes: the continuous rotation was hidden in plain sight as the linear product \(F_Cp\). It is an orthogonal complex structure upstream, and the aggregate intertwiner carries its entire exponential to \(e^{t\varepsilon}\) downstream. The algebraic circle therefore closes without inventing a generator. What remains uncomfortable is physical rather than mathematical: this flow continuously rotates lepton-like and quark-like response directions. Unless it is confined to a boundary pulse, spurion or heavy mediator sector, observed mass and charge structure breaks it strongly. Spin(2,3) is now a credible exact closure of the response grammar; whether nature writes that grammar into its action remains the frontier. See [the continuous Furey product-flow theorem](../1000-1099/1059_the_linear_furey_product_FCp_exponentiates_exactly_to_the_missing_continuous_sp4_channel_rotation_but_its_action_term_is_open.md).

The response grammar can be written as a stable action without pretending it is a bulk symmetry. The Hermitian pulse \(H=\mu I+i gF_Cp\) produces the channel rotation, and \(\mu\ge|g|\) makes its spectrum nonnegative while leaving only a common phase beyond the desired motion. This is an important phase shift in the narrative: unequal Standard-Model masses do not kill the generator if it is a short conversion event rather than an eternal invariance. The hard question moves one rung down to the actual fields—what carries the color and lepton–quark charge through that event, and why does it not produce forbidden decay? See [the positive response-pulse construction](../1000-1099/1060_a_positive_first_order_response_pulse_generates_the_full_furey_channel_flow_without_bulk_degeneracy_but_needs_microscopic_charge_completion.md).

The first answer is unexpectedly economical. The same \(S_1\) leptoquark pattern that appeared as the optional colored completion of the Furey arrow geometry mediates both required crossings through dimension-six operators, while exact separate baryon and lepton number forbid its dangerous diquark uses. This does not make a leptoquark prediction: the conventional color-linear branch still removes it, and full Spin(10) restores the dangerous partners. What it does show is that the last Spin(2,3) generator has a known gauge-compatible carrier at the lowest possible local dimension. The remaining “screw your intellect” detail is phase: nature must orient the two crossed amplitudes oppositely to reproduce \(F_Cp\), and ordinary gauge representation theory is silent about that sign. See [the minimal \(S_1\) completion audit](../1000-1099/1061_the_minimal_sm_field_completion_of_the_furey_channel_pulse_is_a_pair_of_dimension_six_S1_exchange_operators_with_an_underived_relative_phase.md).

The mediator itself now repeats the relational lesson. One carrier coupled to three bilinears forms a rank-one Gram relation and cannot draw only the two desired arms: the third arm appears automatically. To obtain the exact Furey star, the mediator must split into two orthogonal copies, one for each right-hand face, while the common \(QL\) relation overlaps both with phases \(+i\) and \(-i\). “One carrier, two faces, three relationships” has become a concrete UV rank statement—but still a conditional one. The doubled Furey arrows are suggestive precisely because they may supply the two-copy index; the next stop-everything test is whether their mass matrix preserves the required orthogonality. See [the \(S_1\) rank-one obstruction](../1000-1099/1062_one_S1_mediator_cannot_generate_a_pure_FCp_pulse_but_two_orthogonal_copies_realize_the_exact_oriented_star.md).

That stop-everything test exposes a real fault line rather than another effortless coincidence. The doubled arrows provide three allowed couplings to one complex \(S_1\) family; \(S_1^\dagger\) is the other orientation of the same field, not the second carrier demanded by the Wilson rank. Even an added rank-two carrier is unstable in the naive form: its common \(QL\) leg writes an off-diagonal self-energy into copy space and reopens the supposedly absent third relation. The algebraic phrase “one carrier, two faces, three relationships” must therefore be read carefully. A single carrier forces the triangle; a pure open star needs two carriers plus a protection law; and the open star's edge phases are conventional until the rest of the source algebra fixes their frame. This is productive discomfort: either a larger Jordan/Furey multiplet cancels the mixing, a boundary realization evades ordinary bulk renormalization, or the third edge is not noise but the missing closed relational loop. See [the multiplicity and loop-stability audit](../1000-1099/1063_the_doubled_furey_links_do_not_supply_two_S1_copies_and_the_shared_QL_leg_radiatively_breaks_the_naive_orthogonality.md).

Generation makes the same distinction impossible to evade. Orthogonal up-like and down-like mediator spans must be large enough to carry the ranks of both Wilson arms, so \(N\ge r_u+r_d\). If Spin(2,3)'s channel rotation is copied independently across three generations, \(r_u=r_d=3\) and the minimum is six identical \(S_1\) directions—not two. If instead the carrier is one collective flavor ray, two directions still suffice, but the theory owes us the ray and its relation to CKM/PMNS structure. The grand narrative therefore points more naturally toward an aggregate observable/interface carrier than a literal universal particle rotation, unless a genuine flavor-six module emerges elsewhere in the algebra. See [the multigeneration block-Gram theorem](../1000-1099/1064_full_rank_generationwise_FCp_requires_at_least_six_S1_copies_and_the_shared_leg_regenerates_a_three_by_three_forbidden_block.md).

The third relation then does something unexpectedly precise. In the one-carrier triangle it has no holonomy at all: rank-one Gram phases cancel around every loop. But when the two-carrier star is mixed by its common leg, the regenerated edge closes a triangle with Bargmann phase \(\pi\). The failure of sparse closure has manufactured the same kind of central minus sign that recurs in the Pfaffian sheet and antiperiodic placement cover. This is not yet their identity, and it is not handedness—\(\pi\) is fixed by reversal. Still, it is the first microscopic Wilson-network mechanism in this lane that produces a rephasing-invariant central sign rather than placing one by convention. See [the Wilson-triangle \(\pi\)-flux theorem](../1000-1099/1065_the_one_S1_triangle_has_trivial_Bargmann_holonomy_but_shared_leg_mixing_generates_a_rephasing_invariant_pi_flux.md).

Its exact lift chooses between those apparent destinations. The Wilson triangle is an odd real-projective line loop, so its carrier vector returns with a minus sign. But an oriented two-frame built as \((r,Jr)\) returns as \((-r,-Jr)\), a central \(-I\) with determinant \(+1\). The natural bridge therefore lands on coherent antiperiodic transport, not on the sign of the response Pfaffian. This is a useful separation of two recurring minus signs: one negates the entire carrier and disappears quadratically; the other reverses one orientation and crosses the rank-one Jordan wall. Conflating them would erase the very singular/relational distinction the programme is trying to explain. See [the real-projective lift theorem](../1000-1099/1066_the_Wilson_pi_flux_is_the_nontrivial_RP1_line_holonomy_but_its_canonical_frame_lift_is_central_minus_I_not_a_Pfaffian_sheet_flip.md).

Even the missing placement path map now has an exact conditional realization. When the shared relational correction equals the bare carrier scale, \(\kappa=m^2\), the Wilson inverse propagator becomes the \(A_2\) Cartan metric itself up to scale. The three coupling rays become the two simple roots and their sum; two metric reflections are literally the placement arrows \(F\) and \(FA\), and their composition is the three-cycle \(A\). This is a striking convergence: the interaction that spoils the sparse star can, at strong self-consistency, build the integral relationship geometry. Yet the equality is a critical-point condition, not a loop prediction. The narrative advances only if the Jordan/Furey action selects that ratio rather than our recognition of \(A_2\) tuning it by hand. See [the unique Wilson/\(A_2\) matching theorem](../1000-1099/1067_the_Wilson_rays_become_exactly_the_A2_placement_root_system_at_the_unique_shared_leg_strength_kappa_equals_m_squared.md).

The action audit says exactly what kind of principle could do so. The unmarked Jordan cone prefers the maximally isotropic unmixed metric; its trace-normalized log determinant moves away from, not toward, the \(A_2\) point. What selects \(r=1\) is the marked relational triple: either require the placement cycle to be an isometry of the mediator kernel or penalize unequal norms of the three Wilson rays. The former defect and latter variance are both exact squares proportional to \((r-1)^2\). This is perhaps the cleanest small model of the grand narrative so far: Jordan structure stabilizes the carrier, but relationship symmetry lowers it onto the physically organized root lattice. Neither layer substitutes for the other. See [the placement-versus-logdet selector audit](../1000-1099/1068_placement_C3_covariance_selects_the_Wilson_A2_metric_but_the_generic_Jordan_logdet_barrier_selects_the_unmixed_point_instead.md).

The protection law has the same two-layer character. A complex order-three action alone still admits the Hermitian pseudoscalar \(i\varepsilon\); adding a Real structure kills it and leaves only the \(A_2\) metric up to scale. Simultaneously, the three relationships reduce to two carrier coordinates through the invariant relation \(l-u-d=0\). This is an unusually literal realization of “one carrier, two faces, three relationships.” Yet gauge dressing makes the final step uncomfortable: the cycle crosses between \(S_1\) and \(S_1^\dagger\), so the Real operation is not optional decoration but part of the only viable symmetry type. The candidate fundamental object is consequently a graded or antiunitary relational cycle, not a conventional internal \(C_3\) multiplet. See [the \(C_3+\)Real protection theorem](../1000-1099/1069_C3_plus_a_Real_structure_protects_the_Wilson_A2_metric_but_the_gauge_conjugate_source_triplet_requires_a_graded_lift.md).

Even that statement needs one further separation. The conjugations forced by the three physical vertices occur twice around the triangle and therefore cancel topologically; being gauge-conjugate is not enough to be spinorial. The placement cover needs an odd antiunitary voltage, one flip on every edge. That action closes only after the source is completed to all three labels in both orientations, yielding a genuine six-cycle of relationships rather than six new particles. This pins the correct architecture: conjugation-complete coherent root, then neutral Hermitian response, then three-placement population quotient. It also explains why the central sign repeatedly disappears if one starts directly from observables—the decisive sheet lives one rung above them. See [the source-orientation coboundary theorem](../1000-1099/1070_the_physical_S1_orientation_pattern_is_a_zero_flux_coboundary_so_the_placement_six_cycle_requires_the_full_conjugation_doubled_source_triplet.md).

The new Standard-Model code re-entry makes the microscopic discomfort sharper. The two gauge-allowed \(S_1\) arms are not equivalent after the sterile-neutrino puncture: \((QL)(u^ce^c)\) lies in the logical-neutral stabilizer sector, while \((QL)(d^c\nu^c)\) is exactly six minimum logical-\(Z\) components. In the unpunctured \(Spin(10)\) shell both are ordinary zero-sum quartets; selecting the physical puncture creates the asymmetry. The desired \(F_Cp\) rotation therefore crosses a logical boundary. If nature realizes it, the operation must remember more than the neutral response: it must move the encoded logical fibre, descend from a broken unpunctured symmetry, or be imposed by mediator dynamics. This is good convergence rather than failure—the missing generator is being localized ever more precisely at the interface where completion becomes puncture and symmetry becomes relationship. See [the \(S_1\) code-grade theorem](../1000-1099/1071_the_standard_model_code_separates_the_two_S1_FCp_channels_into_stabilizer_and_logical_sectors.md).

The broken-parent option is not vague. The complete \(D_5\) Weyl group contains exactly one Standard-Model-Weyl coset that exchanges the two \(S_1\) operator families. Its representative is the right-isospin reflection \(r_{e_4+e_5}\): it exchanges \(u^c\) with \(d^c\) and \(e^c\) with \(\nu^c\) while leaving the left-handed doublets fixed. The same action that can relate the two Wilson arms therefore moves the sterile puncture. This is an unusually clean symmetry-breaking narrative: completion sees equality; puncture creates logical direction; the low-energy response remembers a broken relation. The next stop-everything calculation is the lifted \(16\,16\,10\) invariant—its \(SU(2)_R\) epsilon may supply the required relative minus, but full unification also restores dangerous colored/diquark partners. See [the exact channel-exchanger coset](../1000-1099/1072_exactly_twelve_D5_Weyl_elements_exchange_the_two_S1_channels_and_all_swap_the_nu_c_and_e_c_punctures.md).

That stop-everything calculation lands positively and painfully. The five-mode Clifford lift gives the unique symmetric vector bilinear and its two alternating contractions: \(ue-d\nu\) and \(u^ce^c-d^c\nu^c\). The relative minus needed by \(F_Cp\) is therefore not arbitrary in the completed theory; it is the \(SU(2)_R\) orientation of the \(Spin(10)\) Clebsch tensor. Yet completion again means accepting every relationship carried by the invariant. One vector mediator still closes the third Wilson edge, and the full colored \(\mathbf6\) restores diquark partners. The grand narrative has reached a precise recurring law: the larger algebra explains the beautiful relation, while physical descent is the art of puncturing it without destroying the residue or unleashing the discarded channels. See [the exact \(16\,16\,10\) Clebsch theorem](../1000-1099/1073_the_spin10_16_16_10_Clebsch_tensor_supplies_the_FCp_relative_minus_but_also_restores_the_third_edge_and_diquark_channels.md).

Nor can completion be repaired by repetition alone. If every extra unified vector carries the same Clebsch orientation, positivity turns the unwanted relation into a norm: \(C_{ud}=-\|u\|_K^2\). It survives any copy number. The first escape is itself Jordan-like: a two-face involution \(D\) twists the completed sign differently on the two mediator sheets, allowing the aggregate response to retain opposite arms while their mutual Gram entry cancels. But the common relationship leg then weights one face more strongly and recreates the loop. The programme has therefore found a very sharp version of its central dance: completion supplies consistency; splitting supplies the desired observable; relationship backreaction tries to complete the loop again. See [the Clebsch-preserving no-go and twisted repair](../1000-1099/1074_positive_Spin10_Clebsch_preserving_copies_can_never_remove_the_third_edge_but_a_twisted_two_copy_involution_can.md).

The cost of retaining the whole completion can now be stated without euphemism. The same colored vector component that carries the two beautiful crossed arms also carries two diquark currents. Its full exchange network has six edges, three of which violate baryon and lepton number together while preserving \(B-L\). The safe relationship is therefore not selected by the anomaly-free charge that helped organize the punctured code. Nor does the present Furey arrow picture yet rescue it: allowed arrows are not a computed one-form Hilbert space, so their apparent duplication cannot be counted as the split mediator carrier. The next honest lowering step must construct the represented one-forms and their kinetic metric—or accept that the unified relationship is high-scale only. See [the unified triplet/proton-decay census](../1000-1099/1075_the_unified_vector_triplet_gives_two_FCp_arms_one_safe_extra_and_three_proton_decay_channels_all_with_BminusL_zero.md).

The next lowering operation is no longer mysterious, but it is explicitly a breaking. The colour–lepton bivector split gives an exact source projector \(\operatorname{diag}(0,1,1,1,0)\) on the five triplet-current types. It retains the complete oriented pair \(u^ce^c-d^c\nu^c\) and the common \(QL\) leg, so only the two desired arms remain. The price is exact: the stabilizer is \(S(U(3)\times U(1))\), and all six Pati–Salam colour–lepton roots are broken. Completion supplies the Clebsch sign; puncture supplies proton safety. A single mediator mass cannot perform this puncture, because the two arms need both conjugate halves of the real six. The missing microscopic object is consequently a vertex selector—perhaps a protected finite-one-form incidence—not another ordinary doublet–triplet mass. See [the proton-safe source-projector theorem](../1000-1099/1076_the_proton_safe_current_projector_exists_only_after_breaking_the_pati_salam_colour_lepton_roots.md).

Nor can that missing object be read off the arrow diagram. With the algebra, Hilbert space, endpoint representation and coarse nonzero edge all held fixed, changing only the unresolved finite Dirac block produces represented one-form multiplicities one, two or three. The same construction can be tensored with a fixed gauge intertwiner, so representation type does not rescue the count; a second independent choice of positive kinetic metric then controls whether the split faces remain orthogonal. “Two arrows” is therefore not “two carriers.” The nested-doll step has acquired an exact input contract: only a represented differential calculus plus its positive kinetic form can decide which mediator rung exists. See [the one-form underdetermination theorem](../1000-1099/1077_coarse_Furey_arrow_incidence_cannot_determine_the_represented_one_form_or_S1_copy_number.md).

Nor does one extra minimal gauge charge protect the puncture. Anomaly cancellation and the four Dirac Yukawas collapse every family-universal \(U(1)_X\) in \(SM+3\nu^c\) to \(\alpha Y+\beta(B-L)\). Once that charge allows the three desired \(S_1\) source maps, both diquark maps are neutral identically. The programme's lowering mechanism therefore cannot be “gauge the classical baryon label” without additional chiral matter. This negative result turns the finite-calculus route from decorative analogy into a leading candidate: a relationship can be absent because the differential module never contains it, even when ordinary gauge charges would allow it. See [the minimal continuous-protector no-go](../1000-1099/1078_no_minimal_family_universal_anomaly_free_U1_can_protect_the_proton_safe_S1_source_mask.md).

A published NCG Pati–Salam model now makes that sentence literal. Its finite geometry routes the left and right alternating leptoquark currents into separate \(H_{3L}\) and \(H_{3R}\) fields, while the diquark currents go to distinct companion fields. This is almost exactly the desired lowering grammar: completion at the \(SU(4)\) level, then relationship-selective splitting in the represented scalar sector. But response positivity reasserts completion one rung later. Mixing the left and right safe fields gives the two opposite \(F_Cp\) arms, while the right alternating current's self-response forces the third edge. The geometry solves which sources exist; it does not make the response graph sparse. This sharpens the grand narrative into two independent questions—source selection and relational closure—rather than asking one symmetry to do both. See [the NCG Model C cross-audit](../1000-1099/1079_NCG_Pati_Salam_Model_C_realizes_the_safe_source_split_but_its_minimal_left_right_pair_still_closes_the_Wilson_triangle.md).

The scalar six itself then reveals the exact danger and the exact kind of cure. Its Hermitian geometry carries like to like and can communicate the two safe left/right faces; its holomorphic epsilon geometry carries unlike to unlike and reconnects leptoquark sources to their diquark companions. The latter is a genuine \(SU(4)\) invariant, not a breaking artifact. Yet a single common complex phase distinguishes the two contractions: Hermitian propagation is neutral while every Pfaffian has charge two. This is the programme's completion/splitting dialectic in one line. The real-type invariant tries to complete the multiplet; a complex orientation can preserve the puncture without killing relational transport. What is not yet earned is that orientation as physics. It must descend from the finite real structure, grading and spectral action and survive the Yukawa and symmetry-breaking sectors. See [the complex-six Pfaffian gate](../1000-1099/1080_the_complex_Pati_Salam_six_has_a_gauge_invariant_Pfaffian_that_reconnects_leptoquark_and_diquark_sources_unless_a_phase_grading_forbids_it.md).

The breaking vacuum makes that survival test unexpectedly Jordan-like. The phase cannot remain globally intact because the six and the symmetry-breaking ten belong to the same same-chirality \(H\)-tensor. Yet the neutrino VEV is a rank-one symmetric form, and every direct \(6\,6\,\overline{10}\,\overline{10}\) contraction dies when two identical rank-one vectors meet an antisymmetric six. Move off that singular stratum and the channel immediately reappears. This is not yet the complete Model C answer, but it is a concrete version of the proposed dance between singular and relational: the rank-deficient vacuum can block the completion channel that generic representation theory permits. The next burden is to prove that all spectral closed paths respect this rank-one annihilation, including mixed \(\Sigma\) paths and quantum corrections. See [the rank-one breaking-spurion theorem](../1000-1099/1081_the_common_H_phase_is_broken_by_the_Pati_Salam_ten_vev_but_a_rank_one_neutrino_spurion_annihilates_the_direct_six_Pfaffian_quartic.md).

At the first nontrivial spectral order, they do. The four particle/conjugate sectors and their three independent finite-Dirac block types form one square. Traversing that square necessarily takes one same-chirality Higgs edge forward and the other backward, so the cross relation is \(H_L^\dagger(\cdots)H_R\), not \(H_L^T JH_R\). The diagonal colour–lepton-breaking \(\Sigma\) background also respects the two exterior-square sectors. The desired relationship and the dangerous completion therefore live in genuinely different path classes: the former is the primitive four-sector loop; the latter needs a self-sector vacuum contraction or a longer/broken-phase escape. This gives the “relationship carrier” a concrete spectral meaning—the allowed relation is a closed oriented path, and its adjoint structure is fixed by how particle and conjugate faces are sewn. See [the minimal spectral-square theorem](../1000-1099/1082_the_minimal_spectral_Pati_Salam_block_graph_forces_cross_six_mixing_to_be_Hermitian_at_quartic_order.md).

The longer-path test then displays the nested-doll structure almost literally. At length six the graph can insert one right-sector out-and-back motion into the primitive square, producing the first word whose VEV reduction could leave a holomorphic \(H_LH_R\) relation. Graph topology has stopped protecting the theory. But the inner component geometry takes over: the two breaking insertions are the same rank-one projector, so the right six is caught in \(P_vA_RP_v=0\). Every candidate through length eight dies this way, while a generic higher-rank relationship immediately survives. Protection is therefore handed from one layer to the next—finite-path orientation at the renormalizable rung, singular Jordan rank at the higher rung. The next serious theorem is whether this handoff persists to every spectral word, not another finite scan. See [the higher-spectral rank-one theorem](../1000-1099/1083_the_first_higher_spectral_holomorphic_cross_six_path_occurs_at_length_six_but_rank_one_breaking_kills_every_candidate_through_length_eight.md).

It does persist throughout the bare spectral word algebra. Once the unique left-six edge is cut, the finite square becomes a tree and the right-Higgs edge becomes a bridge. Bridge crossings alternate, forcing every external right six between two copies of the same rank-one breaking line. Line-preserving \(\Sigma\) excursions cannot change the kernel \(v^TA_Rv=0\). The result is an all-orders separation: Hermitian left/right communication survives, while holomorphic companion reconnection is absent. This is perhaps the cleanest current realization of “singular and relationships”: the relationship is allowed by the ambient group and reappears in the formal path grammar, yet the rank-one boundary makes its actual component map identically zero. The next doll is quantum renormalization, where generic counterterms need not retain the finite-path grammar. See [the all-orders rank-one bridge theorem](../1000-1099/1084_the_minimal_spectral_graph_has_an_all_orders_rank_one_bridge_normal_form_that_forbids_holomorphic_cross_six_mixing.md).

The quantum step is not wholly unprotected: the same zero is the Ward sector of an unbroken colour–lepton reflection. It acts as even on diquarks, odd on leptoquarks and leaves the two-index neutrino vacuum even. In this language the epsilon tensor is the orientation-odd object, while Hermitian propagation is orientation even. The programme's recurring “one twist” has acquired another precise incarnation: an orientation reflection separates the desired relation from its completion channel. Yet the fermionic action identifies this reflection with lepton parity, and three weak lepton zero modes make the instanton vertex odd. Perturbative scalar renormalization is protected within the reflection-even action, but exact nonperturbative protection needs anomaly inflow, extra matter or a different combined discrete symmetry. See [the colour–lepton reflection theorem](../1000-1099/1085_the_rank_one_spectral_zero_is_the_unbroken_colour_lepton_reflection_Ward_sector_but_three_generation_weak_instantons_make_it_nonperturbatively_anomalous.md).

Nor can that discomfort be renamed away by multiplying the reflection with familiar centres. Per family, the bit that distinguishes a quark–lepton relationship from a quark–quark relationship is exactly the bit counted by the weak instanton. With three families, universal protection and mod-two anomaly cancellation are mutually exclusive. This is another appearance of the programme's threefold structure as an obstruction rather than a decoration: an even number of faces closes the parity, the observed odd family count leaves one unit of flux. Whether that flux is tolerated as exponentially small nonperturbative leakage, cancelled by inflow, or absorbed into a non-Abelian flavor action is now a genuine ultraviolet fork. See [the odd-family parity-anomaly no-go](../1000-1099/1086_for_an_odd_number_of_families_any_universal_Z2_that_splits_leptoquark_from_diquark_triplets_has_the_same_mod_two_weak_anomaly.md).

Flavor mixing prevents the simplest redistribution of that flux. Protecting two families would cancel the mod-two anomaly, but an exact diagonal sign then forces every Yukawa matrix into a \(2+1\) block. Once CKM and PMNS connectivity join all three vertices, the only surviving signs are the universal ones and the anomaly returns. The family route therefore has the same carrier/relationship lesson: a disconnected population can carry the desired label, while the observed inter-family relationships erase it unless their breaking is organized by a higher spurion algebra. This pins a concrete model-building burden—derive the mixing graph and the triplet-mixing suppression from the same flavor spurions—or abandon family parity as the ultraviolet cure. See [the connected-Yukawa commutant theorem](../1000-1099/1087_connected_CKM_and_PMNS_Yukawa_graphs_force_any_exact_diagonal_family_Z2_back_to_the_universal_anomalous_class.md).












## Discrete protection after the reflection anomaly: the \(\mathbb Z_9\) opening

The first topological completion is informative but not yet whole. The three-character anchored KO-6 diagram is orientable, yet its antisymmetric intersection form is odd-dimensional and necessarily singular. A fourth \(J\)-paired spectator makes the form primitively nondegenerate, with determinant one. However, a spectator with no new Dirac support does not connect the finite metric: non-scalar algebra elements still commute with \(D_F\). The synthesis therefore distinguishes three layers that were easy to conflate—orientability, Poincaré duality and Dirac connectedness. See [document 1103](../1100-1199/1103_the_orientable_three_character_family_model_fails_Poincare_duality_while_a_fourth_spectator_repairs_the_intersection_form_but_not_Dirac_connectedness.md).

At explicit KO-6 matrix level, the pure two-point idea meets a useful obstruction. Reality forces a self-conjugate bimodule sector to appear twice with opposite chirality, while represented zero-cycles cannot distinguish the copies; orientability fails. A third anchor character replaces the repeated sector by four distinct labels and supplies an explicit orienting cycle. The charge-three edge survives unchanged because the anchor cancels from the endpoint difference. This shows that the needed “third” may be an algebraic anchor rather than a third family gauge charge—possibly an existing internal summand. See [document 1102](../1100-1199/1102_the_minimal_two_point_KO6_family_quartet_fails_orientability_but_one_anchor_character_gives_an_explicit_real_even_first_order_completion.md).

The family arrow also survives its first genuine NCG axiom gate. On a two-point bimodule, first order permits only horizontal or vertical Dirac edges. The \(+3\) family edge is horizontal because its endpoints share the same opposite character; \(J\) reflects it into the vertical \(-3\) edge. A diagonal shortcut is forbidden. Thus “relation plus conjugate relation” is not decorative language here—it is the minimal real closure enforced by the bimodule geometry. Yet this remains a Krajewski-level skeleton, not the physical finite triple: KO signs, grading, full particle multiplicities, junk and the scalar potential remain unresolved. See [document 1101](../1100-1199/1101_the_first_order_condition_allows_the_charge_three_family_edge_only_as_a_horizontal_vertical_real_pair_but_does_not_complete_the_standard_model_finite_triple.md).

The charge-three relation now has a minimal family-algebra explanation. A chosen spectral line \(P_\alpha\) and its rank-two complement generate \(\mathbb C\oplus\mathbb C\).
