Unimodularity of this \(1+2\) representation gives charges \(-2:1\), hence \(I-3P_\alpha\), while the off-block Dirac arrow has charge difference three. In one sentence:
\[
\mathbb C\oplus\mathbb C
\xrightarrow{\det=1}
I-3P_\alpha
\xrightarrow{[D_F,\cdot]}
S_{\pm3}.
\]
This is a compelling local instance of “one carrier, two faces, three relationships”: one selected line, its complementary face, and their charge-three relation. But the family algebra is presently an added factor, and defining it already assumes \(P_\alpha\). The full real spectral triple must both admit the extension and explain why one projector is selected. See [document 1100](../1100-1199/1100_the_minimal_two_point_family_algebra_produces_the_A2_vertex_by_unimodularity_and_a_charge_three_one_form_but_its_full_NCG_embedding_remains_open.md).

The full finite spectral data refine the generation-blind obstruction. The algebra representation alone has the full \(U(3)_F\) commutant, but the charged-lepton Dirac block does not: for a simple spectrum its three Lagrange spectral projectors are canonical weak-basis covariants. They reconstruct the family triangle by \(\Delta_\alpha=I-3P_\alpha\). The universe-facing question therefore moves again: the problem is not how to name \(e,\mu,\tau\), but why one named spectral line becomes the exceptional gauged direction. The same audit shows why the charge-three relation cannot simply be read off from \(D_F\): the required entries split into \(0,\pm3,6\) sectors, whereas an unchanged generation-blind one-form calculus gives family coefficients no new gauge charge. See [document 1099](../1000-1099/1099_the_charged_lepton_Dirac_spectrum_canonically_labels_all_three_family_projectors_but_neither_selects_one_B_minus_3Li_vertex_nor_generates_its_charge_three_flavon.md).

The repeated \(A_2\) has now passed a typed representation test. The placement triangle and the family \(B-3L_i\) triangle both arise by projecting a three-point permutation module with \(P_0=I-J/3\), and their vertices satisfy
\[
\delta_i=-3P_0e_i.
\]
The factor three fixes the relative lattice scale, while the simultaneous \(S_3\) commutant on the trace-zero plane is only the scalars. Thus there is no continuous fitted angle hidden in the comparison. The surviving obstruction is discrete and physical: six possible family-to-placement labelings, none selected by the generation-blind finite algebra. This is exactly the programme's desired phase shift: the bridge is open, but it branches into six typed labelings and must stop the narrative if no source-sensitive operator can distinguish them. See [document 1098](../1000-1099/1098_the_family_B_minus_3Li_orbit_is_exactly_the_trace_zero_placement_A2_module_but_the_intertwiner_is_a_six_choice_label_torsor.md).

The continuous exit is also a precise meeting with known flavored gauge symmetries. For the exceptional family \(i\), the minimal charge table is generated by
\[
X_i=B-2Y-3L_i,
\qquad [X_i]=[B-3L_i]\ \text{modulo gauged hypercharge}.
\]
Thus \(B-3L_i\) itself is not a discovery of this programme. The new structural fact is that the three charge-minimal representatives form a scaled \(A_2\) orbit around the family-universal centroid \(B-L-2Y\): their traceless family vectors sum to zero and have Gram matrix \(9I-3J\). This gives the synthesis a concrete three-way branching object, but not yet the rule that chooses a physical branch. The generation-blind finite algebra commutes with \(U(3)_F\); it can see the orbit only after a family-sensitive Dirac operator, spurion, monodromy or boundary datum breaks that commutant. Any identification with another \(A_2\) plane in the programme requires a typed intertwiner, not a diagrammatic resemblance. See [document 1097](../1000-1099/1097_the_minimal_continuous_lift_is_hypercharge_dressed_B_minus_3Li_and_its_three_family_choices_form_an_A2_orbit_that_generation_blind_NCG_cannot_select.md).

The torsion obstruction also has a constructive continuous exit. Allowing generation-dependent integer lifts while retaining one Higgs turns the full anomaly problem into one linear family sum. Its congruence forces the family count to be a multiple of three. The minimal three-family solution leaves the entire quark Yukawa sector connected but splits leptons into one distinguished family plus a pair. A charge-three relational spurion then reconnects the lepton graph without breaking residual baryon triality, and its insertion order grades both PMNS communication and the Majorana matrix. This is the first point in the branch where “one carrier, two faces, three relationships” acquires a concrete flavor interpretation—one exceptional face, one paired face, and a charge-three relation—but no Jordan or \(Spin(2,3)\) theorem yet selects that interpretation. See [document 1096](../1000-1099/1096_three_families_admit_a_minimal_anomaly_free_continuous_baryon_triality_lift_but_it_forces_a_one_plus_two_lepton_texture_repaired_by_a_charge_three_flavon.md).

The anomaly descent now separates into continuous and torsional layers. Ordinary degree-six descent carries the parent left/right weak coefficients into a broken-phase weak triality coefficient, and all vanish for three families. But it sees only the mod-three shadow. The signed baryon-triality charge is three per generation modulo nine, an \(\eta\)-invariant datum on spin bordism that real differential forms cannot recover. The common family-selection rule is therefore genuine convergence, not yet equality of anomaly classes. Any grand narrative that turns this agreement into a theorem must supply either the combined-group bordism map or a fully anomaly-free continuous ultraviolet lift with its generation-dependent integers and thresholds. See [document 1095](../1000-1099/1095_the_anomaly_polynomial_tracks_the_mod3_shadow_of_the_Pati_Salam_descent_but_the_baryon_triality_mod9_class_is_genuinely_torsional.md).

The vacuum descent is now explicit at global-group level. The rank-one Majorana direction leaves precisely the \(\mathbb Z_6\)-quotiented Standard-Model gauge group connected, while the ninth-root representative cubes to its colour centre. A hypercharge dressing turns that representative into an honest order-three complement, gauge-equivalent to \(B-2Y\). Thus the field-level ninth-root refinement and observable baryon triality are two presentations of one split residual component:
\[
G_{\rm vac}\cong
\frac{SU(3)\times SU(2)\times U(1)}{\mathbb Z_6}
\times\mathbb Z_3.
\]
This is a clean example of the programme's “selection and relation” grammar: the parent component is simple, the vacuum chooses a nontrivial relational dressing, and the quotient exposes the observable symmetry. It still does not derive the component from the Jordan carrier or prove its anomaly matching. See [document 1094](../1000-1099/1094_the_Majorana_vacuum_stabilizer_is_the_Z6_quotiented_standard_model_times_a_split_baryon_triality_with_the_Z9_lift_cubing_to_colour_centre.md).

The ultraviolet group is simpler—and the vacuum mechanism subtler—than a nonsplit extension would suggest. The group generated by \(SU(4)\) and the order-nine lift is exactly \(SU(4)\times\mathbb Z_3\); \(U\) is a gauge-dressed representative of the disconnected component. The central representative has vanishing pure anomaly per Pati–Salam generation but nonzero, opposite mixed anomalies with the two independent weak groups. Three families cancel both. The Majorana direction rejects the bare central representative and preserves the dressed one, so symmetry breaking must transport the parent mixed anomaly data into the low-energy baryon-triality Dai–Freed class. This is a concrete vacuum/relationship mechanism, but the required bordism or Wess–Zumino calculation is still open and has no derived Jordan/\(Spin(2,3)\) origin. See [document 1093](../1000-1099/1093_the_order_nine_operator_is_a_gauge_dressed_component_of_SU4_times_Z3_and_the_three_family_obstruction_moves_into_mixed_weak_anomalies.md).

The gauge quotient supplies an essential distinction. Reducing \(3B\) componentwise modulo three produces \(6Y\), hence a gauge transformation; baryon triality is the residual action of the order-nine extension after dividing by that gauge cube. On gauge-invariant operators the quotient is \(B\bmod3\), and \(B-2Y\) is a convenient elementary-field representative. The standalone spin-bordism/Dai–Freed test assigns both linear and cubic class \(3\pmod9\) per generation, so the observed three generations cancel exactly. This is a nontrivial convergence of quotient topology, weak-instanton counting and particle-half unimodularity—not yet a derivation from the Jordan carrier or a full anomaly computation for the combined Pati–Salam group. See [document 1092](../1000-1099/1092_the_Z9_extension_not_its_naive_mod3_reduction_realizes_baryon_triality_and_matches_the_Dai_Freed_mod9_anomaly.md).

The source-separated Pati–Salam branch now has a precise nonperturbative exit from the anomalous colour–lepton reflection. With neutral Higgs and Majorana-breaking VEVs, the same residue (x=3q_Q+q_L) measures both the one-family weak-instanton phase and minus the holomorphic leptoquark–diquark companion-mixing charge. Three identical families change the condition from the impossible odd-family sign equation to (x\ne0), (3x=0\pmod N). The smallest cyclic realization is \(\mathbb Z_9\) discrete quark number; its faithful quotient on color-singlet observables is baryon triality. This advances the synthesis by supplying a credible exact low-energy Ward sector while preserving the previously derived Hermitian relational channel. It does **not** yet identify that cyclic action with the Jordan carrier, derive it from Furey's algebra, or lift it through unbroken (SU(4)) and the full finite spectral action. See [document 1088](../1000-1099/1088_Z9_is_the_minimal_family_universal_cyclic_lift_that_protects_triplet_companion_mixing_and_its_three_family_quotient_is_baryon_triality.md).

The group-level part of that lift is now exact rather than conjectural. The \(\mathbb Z_9\) generator on \(\mathbf4=\mathbf3\oplus\mathbf1\) is a common twelfth-root module phase times an (SU(4)) (B-L) transformation, with the conjugate module carrying the inverse phase. Its cube is gauge, explaining the baryon-triality quotient, and its tensor squares reproduce both the protected six split and the invariant neutrino ten-plet line. This does not yet connect the cyclic character to the (H_2(\mathbb R)\)/TKK carrier; it identifies the exact finite-module datum whose compatibility with (J_F,\gamma_F,D_F) must be tested. See [document 1089](../1000-1099/1089_the_Z9_quark_number_lift_factors_exactly_into_a_chiral_module_phase_times_Pati_Salam_BminusL_and_its_gauge_quotient_is_baryon_triality.md).

Prakash–Ramya's anomaly code clarifies the arithmetic level of this result without collapsing it into the logical qutrit. The common mod-three object is the puncture-neutral gauge stabilizer \(3(B-L)\equiv3B\equiv6Y\pmod3\), while the physically decisive information lives in the choice of mod-nine lift. The integral \(SO(10)\) lift and the Majorana-compatible baryonic lift differ by \(3L\); one preserves one-family anomaly cancellation, the other preserves the Majorana vacuum and uses the observed three-family multiplicity for cancellation. The identical ninth-root spectra are therefore a shared refinement pattern, not an operator identity or a derivation of \(Spin(2,3)\). See [document 1090](../1000-1099/1090_the_Prakash_Ramya_qutrit_gate_and_Z9_baryon_triality_share_a_ternary_shadow_but_are_inequivalent_ninth_root_lifts.md).

The rank-one Majorana vacuum now selects the refinement rather than merely breaking a phase. Of the three \(3L\)-shifted lifts of the ternary gauge shadow, only \(3B\) is simultaneously vacuum neutral and companion protecting. The corresponding four-sector operator respects \(J_F\), the diagonal grading and the minimal spectral vacuum. Its particle determinant and its weak-instanton phase both close when \(N_f\) is a multiple of three. This is a striking three-generation coherence condition, but it remains downstream of the precise finite-triple normalizer and unimodularity definition and upstream of any Jordan/\(Spin(2,3)\) identification. See [document 1091](../1000-1099/1091_the_rank_one_Majorana_vacuum_uniquely_selects_the_3B_mod9_lift_and_its_four_sector_operator_closes_only_for_three_family_unimodularity.md).

The actual spectral Pati–Salam algebra does not secretly finish this family geometry. It is repeated identically across the three generations, so its full flavor commutant survives, and its connected centre contains only one continuous phase. The family selector is therefore genuinely additional structure. Yet the source theory offers a nonlinear route that the strict first-order toy diagram cannot see: unrestricted inner fluctuations contain \(A_{(2)}\) as well as \(A_{(1)}\). A charge-three linear family carrier would make the quadratic term land in the charge-six sector required by the exceptional Majorana entry. This is a clean instance of the programme's relational-carrier intuition—one traversal is a Dirac relation; two composable traversals can close the Majorana defect—but it remains conditional on the actual represented tensor and junk quotient. The strict-first-order Standard-Model branch and the generalized Pati–Salam branch must therefore remain separate experiments. See [the sourced Pati–Salam family/quadratic fork](../1100-1199/1104_the_spectral_Pati_Salam_algebra_does_not_supply_the_family_anchor_by_itself_but_its_non_first_order_quadratic_fluctuation_is_the_natural_charge_six_completion.md).

The exact generalized-fluctuation formula makes that separation stronger. \(A_{(2)}\) is not the composition of two carrier traversals; it is the opposite-algebra commutator that dresses an already present first-order defect. The horizontal family arrow has the same opposite label at both ends, precisely why it passes first order and precisely why its \(A_{(2)}\) vanishes. Thus the attractive charge identity \(-3-3+6=0\) belongs to the effective composite/operator layer, not automatically to the universal quadratic fluctuation. A genuine spectral realization must locate a physical Majorana edge changing both bimodule labels or build an explicit intermediate path. This is valuable negative convergence: it prevents “quadratic,” “recursive” and “two-hop” from being treated as synonyms. See [the \(A_{(2)}\) support theorem](../1100-1199/1105_the_generalized_quadratic_inner_fluctuation_is_a_first_order_defect_dressing_not_the_square_of_the_charge_three_family_edge.md).

The physical Pati–Salam Majorana edge is exactly such a defect. Reality swaps the two matrix summands, so \(\nu_R\to\nu_R^c\) runs from bimodule type \((X,Y)\) to \((Y,X)\), and the sourced nonlinear fluctuation is the rank-one composite \(H=\Delta\Delta\). Its decomposition \(\operatorname{Sym}^2(2_R,4)=(3_R,10)\oplus(1_R,6)\) gives a concrete example of “two faces, one relation” in the spectral calculus: the two fundamental gauge faces meet on one particle–conjugate carrier. Yet no family conclusion follows, because \(\Delta\) has weak-right and colour–lepton indices only. This separates two previously entangled recursions: the Pati–Salam gauge recursion is derived; the family \(A_2\) recursion is still an extension problem. See [the Majorana \(\Delta^2\) separation theorem](../1100-1199/1106_the_Pati_Salam_Majorana_block_is_a_genuine_diagonal_A2_defect_but_its_Delta_square_is_gauge_not_family_structure.md).

The family extension now has an unexpectedly economical normal form. The selected/unselected neutrino charges demand three Majorana scalar sectors, but they are precisely the symmetric pair sums of two fundamental faces: \(0+0=0\), \(-3+0=-3\), and \(-3-3=-6\). No one-face model can do this, and an exhaustive integral search makes \(\{0,-3\}\) unique at minimal size. The six symmetric family entries split as \(3+2+1\) across those sectors. This is the cleanest mathematical realization so far of the proposed “one carrier, two faces, three relationships”: the carrier is the Pati–Salam \((2_R,4)\) type, the faces are its neutral and charge-three copies, and their symmetric products are the three relational grades. The discomfort is productive—the geometry has not yet earned the second copy, and \(B-3L_i\) cannot be appended as a commuting \(U(1)\) above unbroken \(SU(4)\). See [the two-\(\Delta\)-face theorem](../1100-1199/1107_two_Pati_Salam_Delta_faces_with_charges_zero_and_minus_three_are_the_unique_minimal_quadratic_alphabet_for_the_full_family_Majorana_texture.md).

The obvious associative realization overproduces exactly the direction the Jordan narrative says to remove. Tensoring by the family two-point algebra lets its idempotents resolve separate selected and complement neutral \(\Delta\) fields, alongside the charged cross field. In coarse \(2\times2\) language this is the full Hermitian space with two diagonal populations and a complex relationship. The desired carrier is its population-normal Jordan real form: equal diagonals, arbitrary complex off-diagonal. Jordan symmetrization closes on \(\{I,\sigma_x,\sigma_y\}\); associative completion adds \(\sigma_z\), the unwanted neutral difference. Hence the same operation that reduces the scalar multiplicity also lands exactly on \(H_2(\mathbb R)\to Sp(4,\mathbb R)\cong Spin_0(2,3)\). This is genuine structural convergence, not yet dynamics: the selector acts naturally on equal-dimensional response/copy faces, whereas the fermionic family split is \(1+2\), and the spectral kinetic metric must derive the required normalized exchange. The charge-six object remains the external symmetric tensor of two separately indexed \(\Delta\) factors, since the holomorphic Jordan matrix unit squares to zero internally. See [the population-normal \(\Delta\)-carrier theorem](../1100-1199/1109_the_population_normal_Jordan_selector_removes_the_extra_neutral_Delta_and_recovers_Spin23_but_charge_six_lives_in_an_external_symmetric_square.md) and [the associative multiplicity obstruction](../1100-1199/1108_the_naive_Pati_Salam_tensor_family_algebra_generically_gives_three_Delta_directions_not_the_two_face_carrier.md).

The spectral trace now tells us when that response symmetry can be more than a change of variables. Quadratic kinetic weights can always be absorbed into canonical neutral-copy coordinates, but the quartic remembers the rank split through a scale-free singular-value purity. The selected line has purity one; a generic two-dimensional complement does not. Therefore exact population-normal exchange in the minimal single-trace potential sits on the rank-one stratum of \(QKQ\). This is the programme's “singular versus relational” dance in a literal form: the \(Spin(2,3)\) Jordan face becomes exact when the nominally two-dimensional complement collapses to one active singular direction, while cross-family relations may still restore full rank to the total Majorana matrix. Away from that stratum the symmetry is approximate, with a computable defect \(2r/(1+r)^2\), unless additional spectral paths repair the quartic. See [the kinetic/quartic rank-one gate](../1100-1199/1110_the_minimal_spectral_kinetic_metric_can_be_normalized_to_the_Jordan_face_but_quartic_exchange_forces_the_Q_Majorana_block_to_rank_one.md).

## The first conditional low-energy descent of the Pati–Salam/Jordan pole

The newest branch makes the hierarchy of claims unusually clean. The associative family tensor product overproduces two neutral populations. The population-normal Jordan slice removes their difference and recovers the \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) carrier whose conformal group is \(Sp(4,\mathbb R)\cong Spin_0(2,3)\). The minimal spectral quartic then admits exact neutral-face exchange only on the rank-one stratum \(\operatorname{rank}(QM_RQ)=1\). That singular complementary block does not make the complete Majorana matrix singular when the charged relation reaches its null line. Instead it makes the selected cofactor of \(M_R\) vanish. A Dirac map aligned with the same family flag transports this through seesaw to \(Pm_\nu P=0\). Thus the proposed pole has acquired a conditional experimental edge: a selected-flavour Majorana texture zero, with loss of the zero measuring misalignment between the Jordan selector and the Dirac sector. This is not yet a Standard-Model prediction; it is the sharpest current branch point between a microscopic symmetry, an approximate response symmetry and phenomenological exclusion. See [1111](../1100-1199/1111_a_rank_one_complementary_Majorana_block_can_give_three_heavy_masses_but_block_preserving_seesaw_forces_a_selected_flavour_texture_zero.md).

The first data-facing split is now visible. If the selected family is electron and the Dirac map is aligned, the rank-one Jordan quartic gate permits only normal ordering, with a lightest mass in a narrow few-meV cancellation window; inverted ordering cannot close the three complex mass vectors anywhere in the stated NuFIT 6.0 (3\sigma) box. Muon and tau selections remain less rigid. This does not prove that \(Spin(2,3)\) selects the electron family. It does show how the pole can become scientific: the abstract removal of one copy-space direction becomes a cofactor zero, then a seesaw texture zero, then a branch that experimental mass ordering and Majorana observables can close. See [1112](../1100-1199/1112_the_selected_flavour_texture_zero_keeps_electron_normal_ordering_open_excludes_electron_inverted_ordering_and_leaves_mu_tau_branches_parameter_dependent.md).

The surviving electron/normal branch now has a recognizable geometry of its own: a two-sheeted Majorana-phase curve whose sheets meet at the two degenerate triangle endpoints. This is not another identification of the PMNS triangle with the Jordan cone. The causal chain is stricter: the Jordan copy selector imposes a rank-one heavy cofactor, aligned seesaw transports the cofactor zero, and diagonalization expresses the result as a complex mass triangle. Small misalignment then distinguishes two directions. Motion toward the complementary Majorana null line breaks the low-energy zero at first order; motion along the image line only at second order. In this sense the relational carrier does not merely select a solution—it defines which departures are dangerous. See [1113](../1100-1199/1113_the_surviving_electron_normal_texture_zero_has_two_mirror_Majorana_phase_branches_and_a_narrow_absolute_mass_band.md) and [1114](../1100-1199/1114_Dirac_misalignment_lifts_the_selected_texture_zero_linearly_only_toward_the_complementary_Majorana_null_line.md).

The newest obstruction clarifies where the pole stops being self-sufficient. The Jordan carrier can identify the rank-one stratum and the dangerous null direction, but a generation-blind Pati–Salam algebra cannot distinguish family matrices placed on the same internal arrow. Its first-order condition factorizes and admits safe and dangerous leakage together. The relational picture therefore needs one additional rung: a family-sensitive incidence, normalizer or unique shared spurion that correlates the Dirac and Majorana flags. Without that rung, the heavy-sector Jordan theorem remains exact but the low-energy texture is conditional or tuned. See [1115](../1100-1199/1115_the_generation_blind_Pati_Salam_first_order_calculus_cannot_protect_the_Majorana_null_line_from_Dirac_leakage.md).

The attempt to turn the new null direction into an ordinary family character reveals another version of the programme's central tension. Three relational lines require (mathbb C^3), whose unimodular torus has two generators: the old charge-three selected/complement direction and a new image/null direction. Associative resolution creates an additional gauge field, while KO-6 duality rejects the isolated odd-character sector. The Jordan language is “worse” in precisely the productive sense Aaron anticipated: it displays the desired relational distinction immediately, but lowering that distinction into an associative finite triple demands extra gauge, topological and connectivity data. See [1116](../1100-1199/1116_the_minimal_associative_family_algebra_that_separates_selected_image_and_null_lines_is_C3_and_it_forces_an_extra_U1_plus_the_odd_KO6_obstruction.md).

The extra image/null direction is not simply rejected by anomalies. As a family difference it is perturbatively consistent. What resists is the integral descent: the three elementary relational charges span an index-six lattice, leaving (mathbb Z_6) rather than the previously isolated (mathbb Z_3) baryon triality. The residual two-torsion is therefore another “relationship” that the associative lowering cannot erase. It must be identified with a useful parity, removed by new primitive charge data, or accepted as a falsifiable remnant. See [1117](../1100-1199/1117_the_image_null_U1_is_anomaly_free_but_minimal_three_line_edge_breaking_leaves_Z6_not_baryon_triality_alone.md).

The apparent extra \(\mathbb Z_2\) now illustrates why the programme must track global quotients rather than charge lattices alone. In the covering family torus the VEV lattice leaves \(\mathbb Z_6\), but its order-two element is exactly fermion parity times the weak center on the known spectrum. Quotienting the already gauged spin–weak kernel leaves the same faithful \(\mathbb Z_3\) baryon triality reached by the earlier Pati–Salam descent. This is a genuine convergence: the new image/null refinement changes the covering group without changing the faithful low-energy discrete symmetry. See [1118](../1100-1199/1118_the_covering_residual_Z6_has_an_order_two_spin_weak_center_kernel_so_its_faithful_new_internal_action_is_baryon_triality.md).

The convergence survives the natural scalar completion: any scalar generated from a compatible fermion bilinear inherits the same spin–weak kernel. But the primitive odd-\(Z\) singlet once proposed to remove the extra two-torsion does not. It therefore marks a genuine ultraviolet fork—global quotient versus covering group plus Higgsing—not an omitted scalar within one theory. This is precisely the distinction the Jordan-first programme is meant to expose: identical low-energy relational symmetry can descend from inequivalent global carriers. See [1119](../1100-1199/1119_the_spin_weak_kernel_is_closed_under_bilinear_scalar_generation_and_the_odd_Z_repair_defines_a_distinct_UV_branch.md).

The local texture obstruction also acquires a constructive relational answer. Charges cannot distinguish Majorana from Dirac (P\leftrightarrow N), but the two relationships can occupy different rectangles of a bimodule grid. A sector-dependent opposite-character anchor makes the Majorana edge horizontal and the Dirac edge diagonal, so first order allows the former and forbids the latter. The same three family characters now encode different admissible relationships according to sector: exactly the distinction between objects and relationships that motivated the Jordan-triple programme. The price is concrete—this five-endpoint mask must still be earned inside the complete Pati–Salam real-even geometry. See [1120](../1100-1199/1120_a_sector_dependent_Krajewski_anchor_mask_allows_Majorana_null_sewing_while_forbidding_Dirac_null_leakage.md).

Real-even completion makes the recurring (A_2) structure exact rather than pictorial. Removing self-conjugate orientability defects forces the six directed edges of the three-character triangle, and the physical Dirac/Majorana mask fixes its cyclic chirality. Its intersection form is the primitive antisymmetric (A_2) cycle, whose diagonal null vector is precisely why a fourth character is required. One spectator real pair repairs the symplectic pairing; one real connector pair makes the finite metric connected. The resulting four-character toy geometry is the sharpest associative lowering yet of the three relational lines, while the unresolved physical identification of the fourth character prevents premature unification claims. See [1121](../1100-1199/1121_the_orientable_null_mask_is_an_A2_triangle_and_one_spectator_real_edge_pair_repairs_both_duality_and_connectedness.md).

The physical lowering now bifurcates at the algebra itself. The unreduced Pati–Salam algebra has irreducible complex dimensions (2,2,4) and no character, so the fourth point of the toy geometry is not one of its hidden summands. The reduced Standard-Model algebra has exactly one character and is the only strict-first-order location in which the spectator interpretation can be tested literally. Conversely, keeping full Pati–Salam symmetry means accepting generalized quadratic fluctuations and surrendering the simple diagonal-edge prohibition until it is re-proved for (A_{(1)}+A_{(2)}). This is an instructive “lowering fork”: the same relational target demands different mathematics before and after the first-order boundary. See [1122](../1100-1199/1122_the_unreduced_Pati_Salam_algebra_has_no_character_for_S_so_the_null_mask_splits_into_reduced_first_order_and_generalized_branches.md).

Even the reduced route is not a neutral tensoring operation. To obtain precisely the four relational points, one must use \(\mathcal A_{\rm SM}\oplus\mathbb C^3\): three replicated Standard-Model copies give only three characters, whereas the literal real tensor with \(\mathbb C^3\) gives six. The direct sum therefore turns the relational picture into a concrete extension problem. The internal \(\mathbb C\) may carry the label \(S\), but the \(P,S\) and \(S,P\) sectors and their connector are new crossed-module data. This is exactly the distinction between seeing a pole in the character lattice and proving that the physical finite geometry is organized around it. See [1123](../1100-1199/1123_only_the_direct_sum_reduced_SM_plus_C3_has_the_four_characters_but_it_makes_S_a_genuine_algebra_extension.md).

The next lowering step is uncomfortable but clarifying: the direct sum has the right points and the wrong notion of coexistence. An ordinary bimodule has only two factor supports. Standard-Model particles use those supports to carry their internal gauge representations, so an added family point cannot be a third independent label on the same state. The toy triangle is therefore not false; it is a relational incidence skeleton whose physical realization needs a commuting action, a tensor/higher correspondence or a Jordan/normalizer mechanism. This is exactly where the associative picture stops being an innocent bookkeeping language and begins selecting the ontology of “relation.” See [1124](../1100-1199/1124_the_exact_four_direct_sum_has_a_two_sided_slot_obstruction_to_decorating_physical_SM_fermions.md).

“Wheels within wheels” now has an exact minimal reading. The gauge bimodule is the carrier wheel; the family algebra acts inside its multiplicity commutant; the finite Dirac operator is the axle that makes the nested action dynamically visible. This preserves both gauge supports while supplying the missing third relational datum. The operator space between sectors is naturally ternary, \(\{x,y,z\}=(xy^*z+zy^*x)/2\), rather than another direct-sum coordinate. This makes the Jordan language more than an aesthetic overlay: it is a candidate language for relations nested inside carriers. The remaining hard gate is to show that the physical null-mask relations close on the same \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) slice whose conformal algebra is \(\mathfrak{sp}_4(\mathbb R)\cong\mathfrak{spin}(2,3)\). See [1125](../1100-1199/1125_ophanim_wheels_within_wheels_as_a_nested_commutant_and_Jordan_triple_research_branch.md).

The first closure computation reveals why the pole is local rather than automatically global. The \(P/I\) and \(P/N\) relation wheels are each \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) and each carries \(Spin_0(2,3)\), but because they share \(P\), unrestricted Jordan multiplication generates the missing \(I/N\) relation and all of \(H_3(\mathbb R)\). The envelope is governed by \(Sp(6,\mathbb R)\). This makes the old phrase “one carrier, two faces, three relationships” literal and places the burden exactly: physical composition must remain sector typed. The Jordan triple is valuable precisely because its middle slot can remember which wheel is allowed to mediate the composition. See [1126](../1100-1199/1126_two_overlapping_H2R_null_mask_wheels_generate_H3R_and_raise_Spin23_to_Sp6.md).

The surprising resolution is that the relationship typing was already encoded by the opposite algebra. \(P\) is one carrier only after coarse observation; relationally it has a Dirac lift \((P,N)\) and a Majorana lift \((P,I)\). Retain those nested labels and the two wheels are orthogonal \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) blocks, each with its own \(Spin_0(2,3)\). Erase the inner label and they collapse onto one three-state carrier, generating \(H_3\) and \(Sp(6)\). This is perhaps the cleanest instance yet of the programme’s central claim: singular objects are coarse shadows of typed relationships, and the apparent larger symmetry can be created by forgetting how a relation is carried. See [1127](../1100-1199/1127_opposite_anchor_typing_splits_the_Sp6_envelope_into_two_local_Spin23_relational_wheels.md).

The Möbius gear supplies the missing parity picture. Each external mesh reverses orientation; an odd planar cycle is frustrated, while a half-twist contributes the additional reversal that restores closure. Three is therefore the minimal twisted cycle. In the relational geometry, \(P,I,N\) are its vertices, the Dirac and Majorana wheels supply two contacts, and the third contact is induced by coarse closure. The anchor change is a candidate carrier of the twist, but this remains a hypothesis until its \(\mathbb Z_2\) cocycle and holonomy are derived from \(J\), grading or the full bimodule transport. See [1128](../1100-1199/1128_three_is_the_minimal_Mobius_gear_cycle_and_the_third_relation_of_the_typed_twin_wheels.md).

That derivation reaches a clean boundary. The current oriented sectors are two disconnected triangles; they are the trivial double cover. Reality gives the involution capable of exchanging sheets, but the KO relations do not say which edge transports include that exchange. Four \(J\)-equivariant connections have trivial holonomy and four have Möbius holonomy. The twist is therefore neither disproved nor derived: it is absent from the present axiom data. This is an instructive limit of the grand narrative—its resolution is not another analogy but the concrete parity of mixed blocks in \(\Omega_D^1/\mathcal J\). See [1129](../1100-1199/1129_the_current_KO6_triangle_is_two_oriented_C3_sheets_not_yet_a_Mobius_C6_cover.md) and [1130](../1100-1199/1130_KO6_reality_supplies_the_sheet_involution_but_does_not_determine_Mobius_holonomy.md).

The two possibilities now organize themselves rather than merely competing. Gauge and cyclic covariance compress the connection space to an all-even \(000\) branch and an all-odd \(111\) branch. The former is the two-sheet \(C_3\sqcup C_3\) geometry; the latter is the connected \(C_6\) geometry. This means the next question is not “where is the twist?” but “what is the graded degree of relationship transport?” See [1131](../1100-1199/1131_C3_covariance_and_homogeneous_grading_reduce_eight_holonomies_to_two_canonical_live_branches.md).

Here the Jordan language becomes decisive. Two odd relations have an even binary Jordan product, whereas three odd relations have an odd Jordan triple product. The most coherent synthesis is therefore layered: the observable response algebra can be even and untwisted while the typed relational recursion beneath it is odd and Möbius. Each two-face response block retains its local \(H_2(\mathbb R)\) and \(Spin_0(2,3)\); ternary typing carries the hidden orientation needed to avoid automatic coarse \(H_3/Sp(6)\) closure. This is still a conditional physical bridge, but it is now an exact mathematical target rather than an analogy. See [1132](../1100-1199/1132_binary_Jordan_composition_selects_the_trivial_cover_while_odd_Jordan_triple_recursion_selects_the_Mobius_cover.md).

The first ternary closure test reveals the exact price of that protection. A two-spoke TRO remains closed and does not generate a third carrier arrow; the \(I-N\) relationship occurs instead in its even right linking algebra. This is an unusually clean realization of one carrier, two faces, three relationships: two are odd carrier arrows and the third is their even coefficient relation. It also blocks the easiest Möbius completion. A genuinely odd three-edge cycle needs an additional typed generator or a Real/groupoid lift of the linking coefficient. The Jordan triple is therefore the correct language for preserving type, but not a magic source of missing physical arrows. See [1133](../1100-1199/1133_the_typed_TRO_preserves_the_null_mask_but_cannot_generate_the_third_odd_Mobius_edge.md).

The Real lift has a minimal exact form. A cyclic advance \(\rho\) combined with reality gives \(T=J\rho\), with \(T^3=J\) and \(T^6=1\). Three moves return to the same label with reversed frame; six return completely. This realizes the Möbius/Ophanim “odd gears keep turning” picture without inventing a linear scalar that joins the protected carriers. Its limitation is equally sharp: \(\rho\) is not yet derived from the finite physical commutant, and \(T\) is semilinear rather than an ordinary represented one-form. See [1134](../1100-1199/1134_a_minimal_Real_groupoid_realizes_the_Mobius_C6_without_a_linear_anchor_mixing_seam.md).

But the natural relation rotation cannot play that role. Reality turns a compositional advance into its inverse, so \(JrJ=r^{-1}\) and the generated symmetry is dihedral \(D_3\); every \(Jr^k\) is an order-two reflection. The order-six transport requires a separate parallel connection \(c\) whose action on the conjugate face is opposite to its compositional direction. This is not a defeat of the two-face picture—it identifies its essential contravariance. A physical Möbius lift must distinguish composition from frame transport. See [1135](../1100-1199/1135_the_natural_oriented_relation_rotation_is_dihedral_and_blocks_the_naive_Jrho_Mobius_C6.md).

There are exactly three possible parallel deck flips, and each exposes the same price in a different place: two of its three pairs satisfy first order, while one relation-reversal pair is diagonal and forbidden. The obstruction is cyclically movable but not removable. This gives the spectator and generalized-fluctuation branches a precise job: mediate or dress one reversed relation without promoting it to a dangerous direct scalar. The Möbius geometry is therefore compatible with the relational picture only if the twist is structural or resolved, never a uniformly allowed linear edge. See [1136](../1100-1199/1136_every_parallel_deck_involution_gives_C6_but_contains_one_first_order_forbidden_relation_reversal.md).

The minimal spectator fails that job in an illuminating way. It repairs the symplectic intersection form and makes the left finite metric connected, yet merely adds one leaf to each orientation sheet. The only additional first-order odd bridges that would join those sheets are the direct Dirac/Majorana anchor identifications. Thus metric connectedness and Möbius-cover connectedness are distinct. The associative four-point repair does not erase the need for a genuinely higher relational or generalized mechanism. See [1137](../1100-1199/1137_the_minimal_spectator_completion_cannot_realize_Mobius_holonomy_without_erasing_the_anchor_mask.md).

## Reflexive closure ends at conditional effective closure, not absolute flavour selection

The later reflexive-closure wave supplies the synthesis with a firm stopping rule. The charge-three return can be organized as a conditional effective construction, and the relevant trace moments can be written as a double Jordan frame. Yet a frame-only equivariant response is the identity on every frame, not a selector. More strongly, integrating out any finite collection of fully isotropic cross-Peirce links cannot recover the complementary (\mathbb{CP}^1) data. The programme therefore cannot turn relational closure into absolute flavour orientation without an independently derived anisotropic operator. This is a theorem about the tested closure class, not a universal impossibility claim. See [1203](../1200-1299/1203_terminal_reflexive_closure_audit_conditional_eft_closure_and_sharp_indeterminacy_of_absolute_flavour_selection.md) and [1215](../1200-1299/1215_any_number_of_fully_integrated_isotropic_links_remains_blind_to_the_complementary_frame.md).

## Planckian (t)-(J) transport tests the response carrier without proving the symmetry

The strange-metal calculation offers a different kind of contact with physics. A two-current particle/energy spectral matrix is positive and therefore lives in (H_2(\mathbb R)_+), whose determinant is Lorentzian and whose conformal completion is (Sp(4,\mathbb R)\cong Spin_0(2,3)). The published scalar conductivity occupies only one ray of that cone. This makes thermoelectric rank and determinant concrete observables for the relational response picture, while leaving the microscopic lattice symmetry untouched.

The distinction matters. A diagnostic matrix estimator using (\{H,J_N\}/2) can validate code paths but may force artificial rank collapse. Only a physical energy current derived from the lattice continuity equation can test whether the strange metal has one effective dissipative mode or an interior two-current response. See [1216](../1200-1299/1216_planckian_tj_transport_is_a_scalar_detailed_balance_ray_and_a_testable_two_current_spin23_response_extension.md).

## Leech pair-Gram geometry supplies integral arithmetic, while orientation remains relational data

The positive \(2\times2\) carrier also appears canonically in Leech arithmetic: an ordered pair maps to its Gram matrix in \(H_2(\mathbb R)_+\), and genus-two theta data organizes these pairs under \(Sp(4,\mathbb Z)\). This strengthens the pole interpretation because the same cone now coordinates response theory, Jordan geometry and an exact integral lattice construction.

It also repeats the programme's central warning in arithmetic form. Two positive determinant-fifteen pair lattices do not yield the hyperbolic ternary carrier. One summand must be orientation-reversed, and an affine theta characteristic must still be selected. The lattice supplies the carrier and strata; the typed seam must supply orientation. See [1217](../1200-1299/1217_leech_pair_gram_geometry_reaches_spin23_but_needs_an_orientation_twist_and_affine_theta_shift.md).

## Outcome Dynamics makes numerical convergence part of the pole's admission rule

The bonded GaAs Outcome Dynamics branch adds an operational lesson to the synthesis. Eight independent mechanical source patterns can be carried through an electromechanical action to resolved stress, electrode charge and optical displacement, but rank and reciprocity alone do not make the result trustworthy. The coarse 72-cell map failed lateral refinement, and its through-thickness charge and optical outputs oscillated under linear elements even after load and recovery quadrature had converged.

A same-node quadratic through-thickness element removes that numerical instability on the preregistered 1 MHz normal direction: the final charge, optical and generalized-displacement changes fall below one percent while the linear comparison remains unstable. This is evidence that the earlier parity was a discretization artifact, not evidence for the pole. The branch strengthens the action-to-observable discipline and supplies a conventional testbed in which a separately derived positive two-channel response could be assessed. It does not itself select (H_2(\mathbb R)), derive (Spin_0(2,3)), or reopen the closed selector branches. See [1218](../1200-1299/1218_outcome_dynamics_turns_the_stress_bridge_into_a_converged_numerical_gate_not_evidence_for_fundamental_spin23.md).

The follow-up mass control sharpens the warning. A full consistent-mass formulation converges on the same normal sequence, but its finest charge, optical and generalized-displacement outputs differ from row-sum-lumped mass by roughly 69%, 72% and 65%. Convergence inside one numerical representation is therefore not representation independence. The next gate is consistent-mass lateral/support refinement; the full panel and any pole interpretation remain downstream. See [1219](../1200-1299/1219_outcome_dynamics_consistent_mass_converges_but_disagrees_with_lumped_mass_so_the_gate_remains_open.md).

## Candidate-action blockers relocate the pole from literal spacetime to response geometry

The first executable blocker round changes the preferred interpretation. An unconstrained second physical time fails already in the free scalar sector, while the positive-response realization of \(Spin_0(2,3)\) introduces no extra spacetime coordinate. The candidate effective action itself remains undecided until a complete Hessian, constraint cohomology and boundary spectral audit exist. The pole should therefore be treated as an emergent response geometry unless a separate constrained spacetime construction passes those tests. See [1220](../1200-1299/1220_the_a4_physical_state_gate_blocks_the_typed_action_but_rejects_only_the_naive_two_time_reading.md).

The same round localizes the particularity problem. No equivariant rule can extract a nonfixed orientation from symmetry-fixed data. Absolute family orientation or chirality therefore requires a physical datum that transforms, a broken/history-selected vacuum, a boundary condition, or an index-like asymmetry; it cannot be manufactured by adding more isotropic copies. This is a structural limit on the present self-selection strategy, not evidence for a theological mechanism. See [1221](../1200-1299/1221_symmetric_data_cannot_select_a_nonfixed_orientation_and_a5_requires_a_covariant_selector_input.md).

Finally, the pole now has a bounded operational discriminator. A controlled \(\mathbb Z_3\) sector must generate a positive third response direction transverse to the frozen Standard-Model two-form-factor plane. The synthetic protocol distinguishes rank two from rank three and removes common contact/calibration artifacts. Until the action derives the coupling and an effect window, this is a preregistered question rather than a prediction. See [1222](../1200-1299/1222_a_preregistered_z3_holonomy_response_test_can_separate_a_third_physical_direction_from_ambient_spin23_geometry.md).

## The weight-twelve 691 congruence lives on the arithmetic pole

The exceptional prime (691) enters the synthesis at the correct arithmetic level. The degree-two Klingen lift ([\Delta]) is a weight-twelve modular form on (Sp(4,\mathbb Z)), and Nagaoka's degree-three congruence descends under the Siegel boundary operator to ([\Delta]\equiv\mathcal G_{12}^{(2)}\pmod{691}). A second boundary restriction recovers Ramanujan's classical congruence. Independently, the same tower carries mod-(23) determinant-divisibility and Leech-theta relations. Thus (691) and (23) meet through one Siegel modular tower whose genus-two stage is the arithmetic subgroup of (Sp(4,\mathbb R)\cong Spin_0(2,3)). This is a structural automorphic bridge, not a derivation of a coupling, scale, orientation twist or microscopic continuous symmetry. See [1223](../1200-1299/1223_the_prime_691_reaches_the_spin23_arithmetic_carrier_through_the_weight_twelve_klingen_siegel_tower.md).

## Topological memory is not yet a local force

The A11 observable lane now has a precise microscopic boundary. A pure BF or Chern--Simons sector can store global topological information, but its closed-bulk metric variation supplies no ordinary local Hilbert stress. A Maxwell-like curvature term carries stress, but is blind to a flat connection whose curvature vanishes. The charge-three field that leaves the residual \(\mathbb Z_3\) sector is itself neutral under that residual group, so it can create the remnant without reading which holonomy sector is occupied. The smallest local bridge left open by these no-go results is therefore gapped defect matter with residual charge one or two. Even that is only a carrier: its response tensors must contain a direction outside the frozen rank-two plane before the A11 statistic can see it. See [1227](../1200-1299/1227_pure_bf_is_locally_stress_and_flat_holonomy_blind_while_gapped_unit_charged_matter_is_the_minimal_a11_bridge.md).

The experimental consequence is quantitative. After nuisance projection, identifiability is controlled by \(F=T^TWM_NT\), not by raw rank or a visually nonzero third component. If the retained transverse fraction is zero, no sample size repairs the design. In the preregistered synthetic fixture the one-event 90% target requires 111 runs per sector; a robust two-bin, two-replication joint guarantee requires 144 runs per sector per replication, or 864 sector-runs in total. A nominal one-percent detection threshold requires a true transverse amplitude of about 1.489% for 90% crossing probability. These are planning numbers for a specified synthetic noise model, not predictions of nature. See [1225](../1200-1299/1225_the_a11_effect_window_requires_nuisance_projected_power_not_only_a_nonzero_transverse_response.md).

The platform ladder is correspondingly staged. A passive switched two-port is the quickest analysis and calibration control but supplies no genuine holonomy. Josephson and topolectrical rings can test continuous \(U(1)\) holonomy at three chosen phases, while a protected parafermion or discrete-gauge platform would be needed to realize genuine \(\mathbb Z_3\) sectors. The Planckian two-current branch must first derive its physical energy current, and the GaAs stress-transfer branch must first close its mass and mesh gates. This prevents a useful simulator from being mistaken for the ontology it imitates. See [1226](../1200-1299/1226_a_passive_two_port_is_the_fastest_z3_control_test_but_only_a_parafermion_or_discrete_gauge_platform_would_supply_genuine_z3_sectors.md).

The larger synthesis is therefore narrower and stronger: topology may constrain histories and label sectors, response geometry may organize observable channels, and charged matter may mediate between them. None of those roles entails the others. The physical admission flag remains false until one microscopic action derives the charged carrier, its mass and localization, the response tensors, and an effect size that survives nuisance projection and representation checks.

## The charged bridge exists conditionally, but it needs an oriented readout

The first explicit microscopic model shows that the topology-to-stress gap is crossable without giving the topology a local stress tensor of its own. A gapped charge-one scalar on an oriented cycle acquires a holonomy-shifted spectrum; its matter partition function and connected local-stress covariance distinguish the trivial sector from the nontrivial pair while remaining positive. Thus topology acts as boundary-condition memory and charged matter acts as the local reader. The effect is exponentially or rapidly suppressed as the reader becomes heavy or the cycle grows, and averaging the cycle orientation erases the signed residual. See [1228](../1200-1299/1228_a_gapped_charge_one_scalar_reads_flat_z3_holonomy_through_stress_but_the_third_direction_requires_an_oriented_cycle_and_probe_embedding.md).

Charge conjugation supplies an exact interpretive split. Under reversal, \(C_{-h}=RC_hR^T\). Two probes of the same parity can measure the even contrast between \(h=0\) and \(h=\pm1\), but cannot distinguish the two conjugate sectors. A mixed even/odd probe pair has an orientation-odd cross covariance that can separate them and make the three response matrices span three dimensions. This operational orientation is provided by the loop and probe convention; it is not the missing family selector and should not be promoted into A5. See [1229](../1200-1299/1229_conjugate_z3_sectors_are_degenerate_for_same_parity_probes_but_an_oriented_odd_probe_separates_them_without_solving_a5.md).

The nearest experimental descent preserves the same distinction. An Aharonov--Casher interferometer at three offset-charge phases tests the acquisition and continuous-holonomy logic, while accessible intermediate phases prove that the control space is still \(U(1)\). Genuine protected \(Z_3\) requires clock/shift algebra, sector preparation and permutation, fixed-sector \(6\pi\) return, nonlocal protection and poisoning controls. See [1230](../1200-1299/1230_the_nearest_a11_experiment_is_an_aharonov_casher_two_port_while_protected_z3_requires_verified_sector_algebra_and_scaling.md).

The programme's stopping rule has consequently become structural. A2, A4 and A5 are the construction roots; A7, A6 and A9 turn the construction into a physical operator and matched response; A11 discriminates only at the end. The conditional classical Hilbert tensor is already available, and the pure BF terms are exactly locally stressless. What remains at A7 is the quantum and operational definition: improvement, mixing, contacts, domains and normalized physical ports. See [1231](../1200-1299/1231_genuine_exhaustion_is_a_dependency_frontier_not_a_document_count.md) and [1232](../1200-1299/1232_the_candidate_action_has_a_conditional_classical_stress_tensor_but_a7_stops_at_improvement_contacts_and_physical_probe_normalization.md).

## Terminal synthesis after genuine exhaustion

The expansive reading survives only in a sharply layered form. \(Spin_0(2,3)\cong Sp(4,\mathbb R)\) remains an exact and repeatedly realized completion of positive two-channel response geometry. It is not derived as spacetime symmetry, a unique microscopic gauge symmetry or the cause of three generations. Topology can remember sectors; charged matter can read them; an oriented apparatus can distinguish conjugates; none of these facts supplies the family selector, curved stress normalization or physical port map automatically.

The strongest new family result is the canonical \(\mathcal O(3)\) bundle on the selected-projector completion \(\mathbb{CP}^1\), with index three. The strongest negative result is equally important: its minimal local six-dimensional parent is anomalous, while the vectorlike repair restores mirrors. The mathematical carrier exists; the physical family Dirac theory does not.

The strongest observable result is no longer an uncalibrated third response direction. An allowed scalar improvement changes the integrated matrix statistic. The surviving primary is the traceless spectral pole/support shift, together with a realistic but synthetic sensitivity floor. No current action predicts its absolute shift or residue.

The terminal [exhaustion register](../1400-1499/1453_genuine_exhaustion_leaves_no_untyped_internal_work_but_seven_named_external_or_conditional_frontiers.md) therefore closes internal untyped searching without closing the research programme to new evidence. A5 and A7 are internally exhausted; A2 and A9 have conditional constructions; A4, A6 and A11 require named external inputs. Physical admission remains false.

Two later Zenodo audits sharpen this stopping rule without moving it. The corrected octonionic two-branch flow is an exact CP-Lindblad open-bosonic model with a three-coordinate Lorentz response cone, but its Lie closure is \(SO(2,1)\), its octonionic operator map is assumed, and its preferred axis is not selected. The dissipative QWZ quadrature reproduces as a phenomenological curve, but the exact stationary response of its written \(L=\sigma_z\) Lindbladian is zero. These results enlarge the source and control library while supplying no fundamental \(Spin(2,3)\), protected-\(Z_3\), or physical-admission evidence. The terminal partition is unchanged. See [1454](../1400-1499/1454_the_zenodo_chern_quadrature_reproduces_but_is_not_the_exact_sigma_z_lindblad_hall_response.md), [1455](../1400-1499/1455_the_corrected_octonionic_two_branch_flow_has_an_exact_cp_lindblad_completion_and_a_three_coordinate_lorentz_cone_but_not_full_spin23.md), and [1456](../1400-1499/1456_the_two_zenodo_preprints_strengthen_response_controls_but_do_not_change_the_terminal_gate_partition.md).

The A6 anomaly-versus-mirror obstruction also has a minimal conditional repair. Opposite-six-dimensional-chirality spectators in the same Standard Model representations but in the untwisted \(\mathcal O(0)\) bundle cancel the parent anomaly polynomial on \(M_4\times\mathbb{CP}^1\), while the positive-curvature sphere gives them no massless zero modes. The selected \(\mathcal O(3)\) sector therefore retains three chiral modes without a mirror kernel. This does not yet derive the asymmetric flux assignment, a dynamical family gauge field or the sterile pairing. The \(Spin(2,3)\) pole now reaches an anomaly-free conditional local-parent spectrum, but not its physical origin. See [1457](../1400-1499/1457_opposite_chirality_o0_spectators_cancel_the_o3_parent_anomalies_without_restoring_massless_mirrors.md).

The final current-input audit sharpens this result and changes the action ledger. The zero-index line spectator is uniquely \(\mathcal O(0)\), but it cannot be the other half of the \(\mathcal O(3)\) Clifford module or its real conjugate; it is genuinely independent matter. Separately, the undoubled reflection fold has no local boundary domain satisfying self-adjointness and tangential Lorentz covariance. The boundaryless full wall avoids that no-go and has an exact nonnegative frozen quadratic spectrum, conditionally promoting A4 while forfeiting the fold's pinning and BF parity mechanisms.

The phase and observable lanes stop at equally exact boundaries. A native Peirce conjugation lets the wall sign select one of two real rays, but transport to the sterile phase plane is a finite equivariant Hom-space problem. Physical response requires a sector generator, state/preparation and calibrated ports; symmetry alone leaves shifts, residues and linewidths arbitrary. The resulting partition is A5/A7 internally exhausted, A2/A4/A6/A9 conditionally constructed and A11 externally open. This is complete exhaustion of current inputs, not completion of the physical theory. See [1458](../1400-1499/1458_o0_is_the_unique_zero_index_cp1_spectator_but_no_single_ordinary_dirac_or_real_structure_generates_the_flux_split.md), [1459](../1400-1499/1459_the_a7_a9_a11_lane_is_underidentified_and_reopens_only_with_a_generator_state_port_packet.md), [1460](../1400-1499/1460_an_undoubled_weyl_reflection_fold_has_no_local_covariant_self_adjoint_domain_but_the_full_wall_conditionally_constructs_a4.md), [1461](../1400-1499/1461_the_wall_sign_and_native_peirce_real_structure_select_two_phase_rays_but_transport_to_the_sterile_line_is_the_terminal_a2_a5_gate.md), and [1462](../1400-1499/1462_complete_current_input_exhaustion_promotes_a4_and_a6_conditionally_but_leaves_physical_admission_false.md).

The next charge-sensitive audit resolves that Hom-space to zero. A normalized complex structure remembers an oriented plane but forgets the integer speed of its circle action: the primitive Peirce arrow and the charge-minus-two Majorana coefficient are inequivalent (U(1)) representations. The quadratic charge repair doubles the angle and identifies the two wall-selected rays after projectivization. This is a precise limit of the (Spin(2,3)) response carrier: it does not itself retain the grading needed to manufacture a sterile determinant-line phase. See [1463](../1400-1499/1463_the_rephasing_equivariant_peirce_to_majorana_linear_hom_vanishes_and_every_charge_two_repair_collapses_the_wall_pair.md).

The remaining conditional constructions now have quantitative boundaries. The full wall has a finite reader stability margin but no symmetry-closed zero-cross-coupling quantum subtheory; the index-three sterile sector has no holomorphic (mathcal O(-6)) Majorana coefficient, and any smooth repair is a new defect-bearing field sector. In the observable lane, exhaustive inventory finds no named device containing the complete generator--state--port, calibration, raw-data and protected-sector packet. The path to (Spin(2,3)) therefore remains a derived positive response geometry only after these microscopic and operational maps are supplied. See [1464](../1400-1499/1464_no_existing_named_platform_contains_the_generator_state_port_and_sector_packet_needed_for_a11.md), [1465](../1400-1499/1465_the_full_wall_reader_has_an_exact_positive_stability_margin_but_the_zero_cross_coupling_surface_is_not_symmetry_closed.md), and [1466](../1400-1499/1466_the_o3_sterile_triplet_has_no_holomorphic_majorana_coefficient_and_any_smooth_o_minus6_repair_is_a_new_defect_sector.md).

## The pole now has an explicit idea factory

Exhaustion of declared inputs is not exhaustion of imagination. Claimipedia now separates discovery from justification by allowing theology, scripture, myth, art, dreams, altered-state reports, visionary narratives, failed models and coincidences to seed motifs while granting them no evidential authority. A motif must survive source-blind typed translation, a competing formalization, collision with a named gate, a minimal ansatz, a negative control and a cheap kill test. Beauty ranks the queue but does not update belief. See [1467](../1400-1499/1467_any_source_can_seed_an_ansatz_but_only_typed_translation_collision_and_kill_tests_can_promote_it.md).

The first seeded queue contains eight bounded arcs. The strongest is a translation-without-collapse conjecture: a finite invariant packet may pass through Jordan, Furey, defect, action and calibrated-port languages via natural intertwiners. Its failure mode is equally valuable—a finite list of noncommuting squares and arbitrary basis maps. Descent, ternary mediation, bulk-to-defect functoriality, historical selection, spectral flow, scale recursion and blinded beauty priors form the remaining arcs. None changes physical admission before calculation. See [1468](../1400-1499/1468_theology_altered_state_and_beauty_signposts_generate_eight_typed_spin23_missing_middle_experiments.md).

The first source-blind audit finds that no nonempty declared invariant packet crosses the full Jordan--Furey--defect--action--port chain. The same Spin(2,3) geometry occurs at the positive-carrier and calibrated-response endpoints, but integer charge, chirality/index, anomaly data and port normalization do not yet share a transported identity through the middle. This makes the central fork explicit: either a new graded natural intertwiner unifies the endpoint recurrences, or Spin(2,3) is a recurrent response geometry reached independently in different layers. See [1469](../1400-1499/1469_no_nonempty_invariant_packet_currently_crosses_the_jordan_furey_defect_action_port_chain.md).

The first graded-intertwiner calculation finds a beautiful but restricted seam. Since both the (U(1)) character lattice and (operatorname{Pic}(\mathbb{CP}^1)) are (mathbb Z), tensor-compatible maps are (d(q)=kq). The sterile charges ((-3,0)) select (k=-1) and land exactly on ((\mathcal O(3),\mathcal O(0))); the compensating Majorana coefficient lands on (mathcal O(-6)). This cannot explain the full A6 parent because its selected Standard Model charges are species dependent, include zero and occur with both signs. The alignment is therefore an exact post-selective sterile dictionary, not the origin of the three-family ultraviolet module. See [1470](../1400-1499/1470_the_unique_sterile_charge_to_picard_functor_hits_o3_and_o0_but_cannot_generate_the_full_a6_bundle_split.md).

The species-independent replacement is naturally virtual. The graded parent/spectator module represents ([O(3)]-[O(0)]=3 beta) in reduced K-theory of (CP1): its rank cancels while its degree survives. A superconnection packages the two independent Weyl complexes without pretending they are the chiral halves of one ordinary twist. Its odd sewing is a section of (O(3)), so it must vanish with signed total index three and cannot uniformly annihilate the pair. This turns the incarnation/death-return metaphor into a precise but limited statement: three is the topological residue of failed graded cancellation. The zeros and the Dirac index represent the same class, so they are not independent evidence. See [1471](../1400-1499/1471_the_a6_graded_module_is_the_virtual_class_three_beta_and_any_odd_sewing_has_three_units_of_defect.md).

The residue localizes exactly. A nonzero holomorphic sewing fits into (0 to O(0) to O(3) to O_Z(3) to 0), where the defect scheme has length three; the cubic (z0 z1 (z0-z1)) realizes three distinct fibers. Fanning from this middle upward recovers the degree-three virtual class, while fanning downward meets the observed family permutation module. Both sides decompose as a universal centroid plus the (A2) augmentation plane. This is the first genuine bidirectional convergence in the speculative queue. Its limit is equally exact: three marked points on (CP1) have no projective modulus, so the bare divisor cannot encode continuous masses or mixing. See [1472](../1400-1499/1472_a_nonzero_o3_sewing_has_a_length_three_defect_cokernel_but_not_yet_three_physical_fermion_families.md) and [1473](../1400-1499/1473_top_down_defect_geometry_and_bottom_up_family_space_meet_in_one_plus_a2_but_three_points_have_no_flavour_modulus.md).

Restoring the Fubini--Study metric and one Abelian connection decorates the middle with exactly the right kinds of continuous data for a CKM-like matrix. Three points modulo rotations have three shape invariants; the connected triangle has one cycle holonomy after vertex rephasing. The resulting three magnitudes plus one orientation-sensitive phase mirror the three mixing angles plus one Dirac CP phase. This is a parameter-role convergence, not a prediction: the coupled operator that maps distances and holonomy to the physical overlap matrix is still missing. See [1474](../1400-1499/1474_a_metric_three_defect_triangle_plus_one_loop_phase_matches_the_ckm_parameter_count_but_predicts_no_values.md).

The first spectral quotient prevents overpromotion of that match. A common rescaling of all triangle edges changes masses but not eigenvectors, leaving only two edge ratios and one phase for a single minimal mixing basis. More fundamentally, physical CP violation requires two noncommuting sector operators; if both are functions of one geometric generator, their commutator and Jarlskog invariant vanish. The middle must therefore produce constrained but genuinely different up/down or charged/neutral overlap maps. See [1475](../1400-1499/1475_one_decorated_triangle_has_only_three_eigenvector_parameters_and_one_shared_generator_has_zero_jarlskog.md).

Orientation supplies the smallest successful distinction. The two conjugate triangle operators (H(delta)) and (H(-delta)) arise from one metric graph and have a commutator determinant proportional to (i c^4(a^2-b^2) sin^2(delta) sin(2delta)); triangle anisotropy and loop orientation jointly make it nonzero. This produces a constrained Jarlskog source without introducing a freely fitted second edge matrix. Its beauty comes with a falsifiable cost: the conjugate operators are isospectral, affine sector shifts/scales cannot reproduce arbitrary mass hierarchies, and the physical assignment of orientations to up/down sectors is not yet derived. See [1476](../1400-1499/1476_orientation_conjugate_triangle_operators_have_nonzero_jarlskog_but_an_isospectral_mass_boundary.md).

The cost is not merely aesthetic. Exact conjugacy forces the relative diagonalization (V=U^dagger U^*) to be symmetric, hence (abs(V_ij)=abs(V_ji)). The required contrast can be generated internally: the weighted triangle has the degree operator (D=\operatorname{diag}(a+c,a+b,b+c)). The commutator has an exact completion as the degree-generated isospectral orbit. This supplies the desired separation between spectrum and relative basis without a new family matrix. The first analytic elimination prevents a premature no-go. On a fixed real spectral witness, the maximal derived diagonal orbit makes each mixing entry a sum of three independently oriented phasors with one global phase removed. The pi-flux boundary admits an exact order theorem. There the up matrix is gauge-equivalent to a positive weighted signless Laplacian. A negative affine slope would move the physical middle location above two thirds and is impossible for the up-quark hierarchy. The theorem removes both decreasing-up branches and converts the earlier zero-root observation into a proof. The zero-flux boundary supplies the complementary seam. The up matrix becomes a weighted Laplacian with spectrum \((0,S-R,S+R)\), so a decreasing affine slope can match the up hierarchy only when the normalized edge variance obeys \(R/S=r_u/(2-r_u)\simeq6.79\times10^{-6}\). A nearly equilateral witness simultaneously matches the down hierarchy, proving that the pi-flux exclusion is not global. Its maximal diagonal-orbit CKM audit remains grossly wrong, so the result relocates rather than closes the flavour problem. The relocated problem admits a clean doublet expansion. That new structure now has a minimal exact form. On the relation fiber spanned by the forbidden Dirac link and desired Majorana link, the charge-three action is scalar and cannot separate the two.
